translations.idiomatic: Music Eight

translations.literal: (Music Chapter Two) closing corner bracket〉
translations.idiomatic: (Music Chapter Two) closing section mark〉

sentences.zh: ○明堂大饗皇地祇神州地祇朝日夕月高禖九宮貴神景祐大享明堂二首真宗配位奠幣，《誠安》

translations.literal: ○ Great Hall of Enlightenment grand feast, Imperial Earth Spirit, Earth Spirit of the Divine Land, Morning Sun and Evening Moon, Great Matchmaker, Nine Palaces Noble Spirits; Jingyou era grand Mingtang sacrifice, two hymns; Zhenzong secondary placement offering silks, 《Sincere Repose》
translations.idiomatic: ○ Ming Hall grand offerings—to the Imperial Earth Spirit, the Earth Spirit of the Sacred Land, the Morning Sun and Evening Moon, the High Matchmaker, and the Noble Spirits of the Nine Palaces: two hymns for the Jingyou grand Ming Hall sacrifice; silks offered at Zhenzong's secondary seat, 《Sincere Repose》

translations.literal: Reflect on the cultured sage father; respond in homage before Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Mindful of our sage father's cultured virtue, we answer Heaven above in reverent homage.

translations.literal: The assisting spirit takes the lead; presenting silks, declaring devotion.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit-assistant presides at the rite, offering silks with utmost sincerity.

sentences.zh: 酌獻，《德安》偃革興文，封巒考瑞。

translations.literal: Pouring libation, 《Virtuous Repose》: lay aside weapons and raise culture; ascend the peak to examine auspicious signs.
translations.idiomatic: Libation offering, 《Virtuous Repose》: arms are stilled and letters flourish; the sacred mountain is climbed to read Heaven's omens.

translations.literal: Mighty majesty towers high; truly worthy to receive ancestral sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: His august power rises in towering splendor—rightfully honored at the ancestral altar.

translations.literal: Huangyou era: the Emperor's personal Ming Hall sacrifice, six hymns.
translations.idiomatic: Six hymns for the Huangyou Emperor's personal offering at the Ming Hall.

sentences.zh: 降神，《誠安》維聖享帝，維孝嚴親。

translations.literal: Descent of the spirit, 《Sincere Repose》: only the sage honors Heaven; only filial piety solemnly venerates the parent.
translations.idiomatic: Inviting the spirits down, 《Sincere Repose》: the sage alone may feast Heaven; filial reverence alone may honor the father.

translations.literal: First lay out the dynastic chamber; personally perform the refined burnt offering.
translations.idiomatic: The ancestral hall is newly traced; the Emperor himself conducts the exalted sacrifice.

translations.literal: Bell-drums already set in place; platters and stands already arrayed.
translations.idiomatic: Bronze bells and drums stand ready; every ritual vessel has been laid out.

translations.literal: Utmost sincerity thereby moves; assuredly the supreme spirits descend.
translations.idiomatic: Pure devotion stirs response; the highest gods surely draw near.

translations.literal: Presenting jade and silks, 《Tranquil Repose》
translations.idiomatic: Offering jade and ritual silks, 《Tranquil Repose》

sentences.zh: 乾亨坤慶育函生，路寢明堂致潔誠。

translations.literal: Heaven's prosperity and Earth's blessing nurture all that lives; the inner chamber and Ming Hall display pure sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's fullness and Earth's grace sustain every creature; in the inner hall and Ming Hall we offer unstained devotion.

sentences.zh: 玉帛非馨期感格，降康億載保登平。

translations.literal: Jade and silk are not the fragrance sought for moving response; descend with peace for myriad ages, preserving ascending tranquility.
translations.idiomatic: Not jade or silk alone, but the heart's fragrance, moves Heaven; grant enduring peace through endless ages.

sentences.zh: 酌獻，《慶安》肅肅路寢，相維明堂。

translations.literal: Pouring libation, 《Celebratory Repose》: solemn is the inner chamber, paired with the Ming Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Libation offering, 《Celebratory Repose》: grave and still is the inner hall, joined in rite with the Ming Hall.

translations.literal: The Two Principles observe and approve; the Three Sages assist at the side.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven and Earth look on and assent; the Three Sage Emperors attend as secondary hosts.

translations.literal: The spirit appointment harmoniously unites; the sacrificial rites uniformly solemn.
translations.idiomatic: The sacred season draws all in accord; every step of the ceremony is grave and ordered.

translations.literal: Utmost sincerity brings double blessing; descending fortune without bound.
translations.idiomatic: Sincerity doubled brings blessing doubled; may fortune descend without limit.

translations.literal: Three Sages secondary placement offering silks, 《Faithful Repose》
translations.idiomatic: Silks offered at the Three Sages' secondary seats, 《Faithful Repose》

sentences.zh: 祖功宗德啟隆熙，嚴配交修太室祠。

translations.literal: Ancestral merit and imperial virtue open flourishing brightness; solemn secondary pairing jointly perfected at the Great Chamber sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Ancestral achievement and imperial virtue kindle a radiant age; at the Great Chamber the stern pairing of father and Heaven is jointly perfected.

sentences.zh: 圭幣薦誠知顧享，木支錫羨固邦基。

translations.literal: Jade scepters and silks present sincerity, knowing they will receive enjoyment; the branch-line grants blessings securing the foundation of the state.
translations.idiomatic: With scepter and silk we offer truth, trusting it will be received; the collateral line is granted bounty, firming the realm's foundation.

sentences.zh: 酌獻《孝安》藝祖造邦，二宗紹德。

translations.literal: Pouring libation, 《Filial Repose》: the Founding Ancestor established the realm; the Two Emperors continued the virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Libation offering, 《Filial Repose》: the Founding Ancestor forged the state; the Two Imperial Ancestors carried forward his virtue.

translations.literal: Solemn and harmonious filial offering; ascending to pair with the circular pole.
translations.idiomatic: In grave harmony we offer filial sacrifice, ascending to stand beside Heaven's round summit.

translations.literal: Former instruction has its opening; how can this humble person claim merit!
translations.idiomatic: Our forebears' teaching laid the way—what strength has this unworthy frame to claim?

translations.literal: Fragrant offerings accepted, blessings granted; protecting the people in glorious abundance.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven delights in the fragrance and bestows bounty, sheltering the people in radiant plenty.

sentences.zh: 送神，《誠安》我將我享，辟公顯助。

translations.literal: Sending off the spirit, 《Sincere Repose》: I advance to my offering; the Duke aids in manifestation.
translations.idiomatic: Escorting the spirits away, 《Sincere Repose》: I come forward to feast them; the Duke of Zhou lends his bright assistance.

translations.literal: Offerings ended, vessels cleared; rites complete, music fully arrayed.
translations.idiomatic: The last gifts are given and the trays withdrawn; the rite is finished and every note in place.

translations.literal: Ornamented carriage ascends on high; rising smoke soars upward.
translations.idiomatic: The adorned chariot climbs heavenward; incense smoke mounts into the empyrean.

translations.literal: The spirits protect and now return; grant this glorious fortune.
translations.idiomatic: The gods guard us and take their leave; bestow upon us this radiant destiny.

translations.literal: Jiayou era: the Emperor's personal Ming Hall sacrifice, two hymns.
translations.idiomatic: Two hymns for the Jiayou Emperor's personal offering at the Ming Hall.

sentences.zh: 降神，《誠安》燁燁房、心，下照重屋。

translations.literal: Descent of the spirit, 《Sincere Repose》: blazing are the Room and Heart stars, shining down upon the double-roofed hall.
translations.idiomatic: Inviting the spirits down, 《Sincere Repose》: the Heart and Room stars blaze bright, casting their light upon the layered hall.

translations.literal: We solemnly honor the Emperor's parent; not a secondary placement that would profane.
translations.idiomatic: We reverently feast the imperial forebear—no careless pairing that would defile the rite.

translations.literal: Western Radiance in vast mist; evening light already solemn.
translations.idiomatic: The western heavens swell with autumn haze; evening's light turns grave and still.

translations.literal: May the spirits come; excellent offerings fragrant and rich.
translations.idiomatic: O spirits, draw near; we bring fine offerings, sweet and overflowing.

translations.literal: Sending off the spirit, 《Sincere Repose》
translations.idiomatic: Escorting the spirits away, 《Sincere Repose》

translations.literal: Bright is the combined hall; none more honored than revering Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Radiant is the unified hall—nothing surpasses honoring Heaven.

translations.literal: Rites and music harmoniously accomplished; essence and spirit in accord.
translations.idiomatic: Rite and melody flourish to completion; spirit and substance meet as one.

translations.literal: Osmanthus wine first emptied; feathered carriage swiftly departs.
translations.idiomatic: The cassia goblets stand drained; the spirit-carriage on feathered wheels is gone in an instant.

translations.literal: Bequeathing us auspicious omens, glorious for ten thousand generations.
translations.idiomatic: They leave us blessed omens, shining through ten thousand ages.

sentences.zh: 熙寧享明堂二首英宗奠幣，《誠安》

translations.literal: Xining era Ming Hall sacrifice, two hymns; Yingzong offering silks, 《Sincere Repose》
translations.idiomatic: Two hymns for the Xining Ming Hall sacrifice; silks offered to Emperor Yingzong, 《Sincere Repose》

translations.literal: Oh august sage father, able to be paired with the Supreme Lord.
translations.idiomatic: O glorious sage father, fit to stand beside the Supreme Lord.

translations.literal: Forever speak filial remembrance; brightly offering excellent silks.
translations.idiomatic: Ever mindful in filial devotion, we brightly present these fine ritual silks.

sentences.zh: 酌獻，《德安》英聲邁古，施德在民。

translations.literal: Pouring libation, 《Virtuous Repose》: heroic renown surpassing antiquity; extending virtue among the people.
translations.idiomatic: Libation offering, 《Virtuous Repose》: his fame outshines the ancients; his virtue flows among the people.

translations.literal: Truly ordering the ancestral sacrifice; hosting and extending welcome to the supreme spirits.
translations.idiomatic: Rightly arrayed at the ancestral feast, we receive and welcome the highest gods.

translations.literal: Yuanfu era: the Emperor's personal Ming Hall sacrifice, eleven hymns.
translations.idiomatic: Eleven hymns for the Yuanfu Emperor's personal offering at the Ming Hall.

sentences.zh: 皇帝升降，《儀安》嚴父配天，孝乎明堂。

translations.literal: Emperor ascending and descending, 《Ritual Repose》: the stern father paired with Heaven—filial piety in the Ming Hall.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor's ascent and descent, 《Ritual Repose》: the awe-inspiring father paired with Heaven—filial piety fulfilled in the Ming Hall.

translations.literal: With offerings ascending the steps; descending tones to lead.
translations.idiomatic: Bearing gifts he climbs the steps; descending music leads the way.

translations.literal: Heaven's pace has its measure; the Emperor's demeanor must be solemn.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's stride keeps its rhythm; the Son of Heaven's bearing must be grave.

translations.literal: The Duke takes it as norm; the fundamental rites are without flaw.
translations.idiomatic: The Duke of Zhou holds it as law; the root of ritual knows no defect.

translations.literal: Supreme Lord's seat: presenting jade and silks, 《Tranquil Repose》
translations.idiomatic: At the Supreme Lord's place: offering jade and ritual silks, 《Tranquil Repose》

translations.literal: The sage can honor Heaven; filial piety can serve the parent.
translations.idiomatic: Only the sage may feast Heaven; only filial devotion may serve the father.

translations.literal: Oh august ancestral sacrifice; the grand rite is here displayed.
translations.idiomatic: O glorious ancestral feast—the supreme ceremony is here set forth.

translations.literal: With what shall we present devotion?
translations.idiomatic: How shall we offer our reverence?

translations.literal: The two essences are splendid.
translations.idiomatic: Jade and silk blaze with splendor.

translations.literal: With what shall we bring auspiciousness?
translations.idiomatic: How shall we summon blessing?

translations.literal: The Supreme Heaven observes and approves.
translations.idiomatic: High Heaven looks on and assents.

sentences.zh: 神宗奠幣，《信安》合宮禮備，時維哲王。

translations.literal: Shenzong offering silks, 《Faithful Repose》: the combined hall rites complete; the time is the wise king's.
translations.idiomatic: Silks offered to Emperor Shenzong, 《Faithful Repose》: the unified hall's rites stand complete—in the era of the sage king.

translations.literal: The hall feast open on four sides; bright virtue fragrant.
translations.idiomatic: The hall's banquet opens on every side; luminous virtue rises like incense.

translations.literal: The sage father comes down; blessings descend in abundance.
translations.idiomatic: The sage forebear draws near; fortune rains down in overflowing measure.

translations.literal: In succession after succession; ten thousand sacrifices ever flourishing.
translations.idiomatic: Generation after generation in unbroken line—may ten thousand offerings ever flourish.

sentences.zh: 奉俎，《禧安》奕奕明堂，天子即事。

translations.literal: Presenting the sacrificial meat, 《Auspicious Repose》: grand is the Ming Hall; the Son of Heaven attends to the rite.
translations.idiomatic: Offering the sacrificial tray, 《Auspicious Repose》: splendid rises the Ming Hall; the Son of Heaven takes up the ceremony.

translations.literal: We set out our sage father, paired with the Supreme Lord.
translations.idiomatic: We place our sage forebear beside the Supreme Lord.

translations.literal: Of all the hundred offices, who dares not be reverent!
translations.idiomatic: Among every rank and office, who would dare withhold reverence!

translations.literal: The tray pure, the victim fat; its presentation has proper form.
translations.idiomatic: The offering-board is clean, the sacrifice plump; its ascent follows every rule.

sentences.zh: 上帝位酌獻，《慶安》惟禮不瀆，所以嚴親。

translations.literal: Supreme Lord's seat pouring libation, 《Celebratory Repose》: only through ritual without profanation can the parent be solemnly honored.
translations.idiomatic: Libation at the Supreme Lord's place, 《Celebratory Repose》: only unblemished ritual can solemnly honor the father.

translations.literal: Only filial piety without exhaustion can thus teach the people.
translations.idiomatic: Only inexhaustible filial devotion can instruct the people.

translations.literal: Ascending to pair with Wen, the father; enjoying Heaven's great spirit.
translations.idiomatic: He ascends to stand with his cultured father and feasts Heaven's supreme god.

translations.literal: Double jubilation, accumulated blessings; fortune's line without limit.
translations.idiomatic: Blessing upon blessing, fortune heaped on fortune—may the imperial line know no end.

translations.literal: Secondary placement pouring libation, 《Virtuous Repose》
translations.idiomatic: Libation at the secondary seat, 《Virtuous Repose》

translations.literal: Grand achievement, brilliant virtue; both possess blazing glory.
translations.idiomatic: Towering deeds and swift virtue—each burns with radiant splendor.

translations.literal: Ascending to pair at the ancestral sacrifice; grace to us without bound.
translations.idiomatic: Raised to the ancestral feast in paired honor—grace us without limit.

sentences.zh: 退文舞、迎武舞，《穆安》舞以象功，樂惟崇德。

translations.literal: Retiring civil dance, welcoming martial dance, 《Solemn Repose》: dance to image merit; music only exalts virtue.
translations.idiomatic: The civil dancers withdraw, the martial dancers enter, 《Solemn Repose》: dance images achievement; music exalts virtue alone.

translations.literal: Culture governs the myriad domains; martial prowess pacifies the four quarters.
translations.idiomatic: Letters order the myriad states; arms still the four realms.

translations.literal: One taut, one relaxed; the pattern never errs.
translations.idiomatic: Now drawn tight, now eased—the ceremony never strays.

translations.literal: The spirits' scrutiny clearly revealed; filial remembrance is the standard.
translations.idiomatic: The gods' gaze shines clear; filial devotion is the measure of all.

sentences.zh: 亞獻，《穆安》於昭盛禮，嚴父配天。

translations.literal: Secondary offering, 《Solemn Repose》: manifest is the grand rite; the stern father paired with Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Second libation, 《Solemn Repose》: bright shines the supreme ceremony—the awe-inspiring father paired with Heaven.

translations.literal: Fully offering all things with full sincerity; none not pure and auspicious.
translations.idiomatic: Every gift given, every heart laid bare—nothing but the pure and blessed.

translations.literal: Double goblets already presented; nine performances mutually proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: The paired cups are offered; nine movements of music resound together.

translations.literal: The spirits grant glorious fortune for millions upon millions of years.
translations.idiomatic: The gods bestow radiant blessing—for millions upon millions of years.

translations.literal: Drinking the blessing, 《Sacrificial Repose》
translations.idiomatic: Partaking of the sacred blessing, 《Sacrificial Repose》

translations.literal: None more honored than Heaven; none more kin than the father.
translations.idiomatic: Nothing is higher than Heaven; nothing is closer than the father.

translations.literal: Already offered and assisted; sincerity extended, rites raised.
translations.idiomatic: Feast and assistance complete—devotion declared, the ceremony fulfilled.

translations.literal: The percussive strokes on the hall; the eight sounds now complete.
translations.idiomatic: The sounding-stones ring in the hall; the eight tones stand fully arrayed.

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven myriad years; drinking the spirit's sacrificial flesh.
translations.idiomatic: May the Son of Heaven live ten thousand ages, partaking of the gods' consecrated meat.

sentences.zh: 徹豆，《欽安》穆穆在堂，肅肅在庭。

translations.literal: Clearing the vessels, 《Reverent Repose》: solemn solemnity in the hall; grave gravity in the courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: Withdrawing the offering-trays, 《Reverent Repose》: deep stillness fills the hall; grave order fills the court.

translations.literal: Oh manifest Duke; coming to assist, thoughts accomplished.
translations.idiomatic: O glorious Duke of Zhou, come to aid—the rite is brought to completion.

translations.literal: The spirits having accepted and ceased; there is perception yet no sound.
translations.idiomatic: The gods have delighted and departed—felt though unheard.

translations.literal: Grant us excellent auspiciousness; peace extending to all living beings.
translations.idiomatic: Bestow on us fine blessing; let peace reach every living thing.

sentences.zh: 歸大次，《憩安》有奕明堂，萬方時會。

translations.literal: Return to the great pavilion, 《Restful Repose》: splendid is the Ming Hall; the myriad regions gather in season.
translations.idiomatic: Returning to the great rest-pavilion, 《Restful Repose》: glorious is the Ming Hall; the ten thousand regions assemble in their season.

translations.literal: The imperial descendant, the sage father, made the Lord's secondary pair.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial heir, our sage forebear, stands as Heaven's secondary guest.

translations.literal: Music draws on the Shun canon; rites follow Zhou records.
translations.idiomatic: Music draws from Shun's ancient canon; ritual follows the Zhou pattern.

translations.literal: The refined rite is now complete; oh august, it has come to fruition.
translations.idiomatic: The sacred business is accomplished—O glorious day, it has come to pass.

sentences.zh: 大觀宗祀明堂五首奠玉幣，《鎮安》交於神明，內心為貴。

translations.literal: Daguan ancestral sacrifice Ming Hall five hymns, presenting jade and silks, 《Tranquil Repose》: communing with the divine spirits; the inner heart is what counts.
translations.idiomatic: Five hymns for the Daguan ancestral Ming Hall sacrifice; offering jade and silks, 《Tranquil Repose》: in meeting the gods, the inner heart is supreme.

translations.literal: Outwardly displaying its pattern; also manifesting refined intent.
translations.idiomatic: Outwardly we show every ornament; inwardly we mirror pure devotion.

translations.literal: Fine jade already laid out; about to be measured as offering silks.
translations.idiomatic: The fine jade stands displayed, ready to be offered as measured silks.

translations.literal: Solemn and harmonious.
translations.idiomatic: Grave in bearing, harmonious in spirit.

translations.literal: Only for the Lord's response.
translations.idiomatic: All for Heaven's answering presence.

translations.literal: A state that serves the spirits; honoring Heaven is supreme.
translations.idiomatic: A realm that serves the gods holds feasting Heaven as the highest honor.

translations.literal: In the inner heart achieve virtue; outwardly display abundant culture.
translations.idiomatic: Virtue is perfected within; every outward ornament proclaims it.

translations.literal: Fine jade displays its treasure; offered with measured silks.
translations.idiomatic: Choice jade shows its worth; measured silks are laid before the altar.

translations.literal: Reverently to honor—what is it for?
translations.idiomatic: What do we reverently honor?

translations.literal: Only for the ancestral sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Only for the ancestral rite.

sentences.zh: 配位奠幣，《信安》肇祀明堂，告成大報。

translations.literal: Secondary placement offering silks, 《Faithful Repose》: initiating sacrifice at the Ming Hall, announcing the great recompense.
translations.idiomatic: Silks offered at the secondary seat, 《Faithful Repose》: the Ming Hall sacrifice begins; the great recompense is proclaimed.

translations.literal: Solemn and reverent, reverent and solemn; leading to behold the luminous father.
translations.idiomatic: Grave and reverent, reverent and grave—we are led to behold our luminous forebear.

translations.literal: Carefully choosing an auspicious day; fasting pure from morning to evening.
translations.idiomatic: An auspicious day is chosen with care; from dawn to dusk we keep the fast in purity.

translations.literal: Oh august sovereign king; filial thought without limit.
translations.idiomatic: O august sovereign—filial devotion knows no bound.

sentences.zh: 酌獻，《孝安》若昔大猷，孝思維則。

translations.literal: Pouring libation, 《Filial Repose》: like the great plan of old; filial thought is the standard.
translations.idiomatic: Libation offering, 《Filial Repose》: as in the great design of antiquity—filial devotion is the rule.

translations.literal: Ever speaking filial thought; greatly inheriting his virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Forever mindful in filial devotion, we grandly carry forward his virtue.

translations.literal: Oh clear and bright majesty; assisting at the Supreme Lord.
translations.idiomatic: Clear and radiant is his majesty, assisting Heaven on high.

translations.literal: Carrying my thoughts to completion; forever securing blessed fortune.
translations.idiomatic: May our thoughts reach fulfillment; may blessed fortune endure forever.

sentences.zh: 配位酌獻，《大明》於昭皇考，大明體神。

translations.literal: Secondary placement pouring libation, 《Great Brightness》: oh clear is the imperial father; great brightness embodies the spirit.
translations.idiomatic: Libation at the secondary seat, 《Great Brightness》: bright shines the imperial father—great radiance, the very body of the spirit.

translations.literal: Patterned after cultured thought; fitting for the people, fitting for men.
translations.idiomatic: His model follows cultured wisdom, bringing harmony to the people and to all beneath Heaven.

translations.literal: The way of the stern father; ascending to be paired with Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The awe-inspiring father's way ascends to stand paired with Heaven.

translations.literal: Personally performing filial announcement; having sincerity toward the ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: In person we perform the filial proclamation, keeping faith with those who went before.

sentences.zh: 紹興親享明堂二十六首

translations.literal: Shaoxing era: the Emperor's personal Ming Hall sacrifice, twenty-six hymns.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-six hymns for the Shaoxing Emperor's personal Ming Hall sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 皇帝入門，《儀安》惟我有宋，昊天子之。

translations.literal: Emperor entering the gate, 《Ritual Repose》: only we have Song; the Lord of Heaven's Son.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor enters the gate, 《Ritual Repose》: Song is ours alone—the Son of the Lord on High.

translations.literal: After three years divining the sacrifice; a hundred generations inheriting the foundation.
translations.idiomatic: Three years on, the sacrifice is divined; for a hundred generations the foundation is handed down.

translations.literal: Extending to the young and humble; presenting sacrificial victims to worship.
translations.idiomatic: Blessing reaches even the young and lowly; victims are offered in worship.

translations.literal: Daring not forget fasting and trembling reverence; everywhere performing the supreme rites.
translations.idiomatic: We dare not forget the fast and trembling awe; in every detail we perform the highest rite.

translations.literal: Ascending the hall, 《Ritual Repose》
translations.idiomatic: Ascending the hall, 《Ritual Repose》

translations.literal: Oh splendid Ming Hall; first proclaiming the burnt offering sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Splendid rises the Ming Hall—the burnt offering is first proclaimed.

translations.literal: Ancestors come to visit; also assisting at the Lord.
translations.idiomatic: The ancestors come to join the rite, assisting Heaven as well.

translations.literal: The nine provinces gallop in haste; the hundred ministers all perform the rite.
translations.idiomatic: The nine provinces rush to attend; every minister fulfills his part.

translations.literal: Gathering this season's pure blessing; granting us ten thousand generations.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's pure blessing is gathered in this season—may it be granted us for ten thousand generations.

translations.literal: Descent of the spirit, 《Sincere Repose》: alas, to what are the spirits close?
translations.idiomatic: Inviting the spirits down, 《Sincere Repose》: to what do the gods draw near?

translations.literal: Only virtue is what they assist.
translations.idiomatic: Only virtue draws them near.

translations.literal: Jade and victims fully laid out; with sincerity they then come to look upon us.
translations.idiomatic: Jade and victims stand arrayed—with sincerity, the spirits come to behold us.

translations.literal: We open the Ming Hall, following the state's ancient precedent.
translations.idiomatic: We open the Ming Hall, keeping to the realm's ancient custom.

translations.literal: May we still receive their dwelling and enjoyment; thereby deepening ancestral blessing.
translations.idiomatic: May they still deign to dwell and feast here, deepening the ancestral blessing.

sentences.zh: 盥洗，《儀安》肇開九筵，維古之仿。

translations.literal: Ritual ablution, 《Ritual Repose》: first opening the nine mats; modeled on antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: Ablution, 《Ritual Repose》: the nine mats are first laid out—after the pattern of old.

translations.literal: Grand and glorious great spirits; come to look upon us, come to feast.
translations.idiomatic: O glorious great spirits—come to behold us, come to feast.

translations.literal: The myriad rites mutually perfected; the hundred ministers clearly assisting.
translations.idiomatic: Every rite is perfected in turn; the hundred ministers stand forth to assist.

translations.literal: Subtle sincerity from within; communing between Heaven and earth.
translations.idiomatic: Subtle sincerity rises from the heart, joining Heaven and earth in communion.

sentences.zh: 上帝位奠玉幣，《鎮安》皇皇后帝，周覽四方。

translations.literal: Supreme Lord's seat presenting jade and silks, 《Tranquil Repose》: august Lord on High; surveying the four directions.
translations.idiomatic: At the Supreme Lord's place, offering jade and silks, 《Tranquil Repose》: O Lord on High, surveying the four quarters.

translations.literal: Looking fondly on our former glorious ones; at ease in this hall.
translations.idiomatic: He looks with favor on our glorious forebears—at peace in this hall.

translations.literal: Golden branches splendidly displayed; embroidered banners raised high.
translations.idiomatic: Golden finery shines in splendor; broidered banners rise on high.

translations.literal: Generation after generation delighting in the bright sacrifice; Song is the constant.
translations.idiomatic: Age after age they delight in this bright rite—Song shall keep it forever.

translations.literal: Imperial Earth Spirit's seat presenting jade and silks, 《Fine Repose》
translations.idiomatic: At the Imperial Earth Spirit's place, offering jade and silks, 《Fine Repose》

translations.literal: Supreme is the Earth Principle; sustaining and bearing the myriad things!
translations.idiomatic: Supreme is Earth's power—sustaining and upholding the myriad things!

translations.literal: Continuing Heaven's divine sagacity; observing the age's order and neglect.
translations.idiomatic: Continuing Heaven's sacred wisdom, discerning whether the age is governed or neglected.

translations.literal: Praising the Earth Spirit's hall; offering with jade scepter and embroidered silks.
translations.idiomatic: We praise the hall of the Earth Spirit, offering jade scepter and embroidered silks.

translations.literal: Who makes the state's blessing? The four seas without rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Who brings the realm its blessing? When the four seas harbor no discord.

sentences.zh: 太祖位奠幣，《廣安》推尊太元，重屋為盛。

translations.literal: Founding Ancestor's seat offering silks, 《Broad Repose》: exalting the Supreme Origin; layered halls as the grandeur.
translations.idiomatic: Silks offered at the Founding Ancestor's seat, 《Broad Repose》: the Supreme Origin is exalted—the layered hall is the supreme grandeur.

translations.literal: Who shall be paired with it?
translations.idiomatic: Who is fit to stand as its counterpart?

translations.literal: Our ancestor equal to the sage.
translations.idiomatic: Our ancestor, equal to the sage.

translations.literal: Opening the foundation, grasping the talisman; securing the throne, fixing the mandate.
translations.idiomatic: He opened the foundation and seized the heavenly token; he took the throne and fixed the mandate.

translations.literal: For ten thousand such years; the filial descendant has celebration.
translations.idiomatic: For ten thousand years the filial heir shall know blessing.

sentences.zh: 太宗位奠幣，《化安》帝神來格，靡祀不從。

translations.literal: Taizong's seat offering silks, 《Transformative Repose》: the Lord's spirit comes to lodge; no sacrifice not followed.
translations.idiomatic: Silks offered at Emperor Taizong's seat, 《Transformative Repose》: the imperial spirit descends—no rite goes unheeded.

translations.literal: Assisting seated to feast; alone ascending are the ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: He sits beside Heaven to feast; the ancestors alone ascend to share the offering.

translations.literal: In the court reverent and solemn; displaying colors in layered array.
translations.idiomatic: Reverent solemnity fills the court; colors and ornaments are layered in splendor.

translations.literal: The rite of three libations; the bearing of a hundred years.
translations.idiomatic: The threefold libation rite—the bearing of a hundred-year dynasty.

sentences.zh: 徽宗位奠幣，《泰安》於穆帝臨，至矣元造！

translations.literal: Huizong's seat offering silks, 《Pacific Repose》: oh solemn is the Lord's presence; supreme is the primal creation!
translations.idiomatic: Silks offered at Emperor Huizong's seat, 《Pacific Repose》: solemn is the imperial presence—supreme is the primal creation!

translations.literal: Able to match its rite; only our cultured father.
translations.idiomatic: He matches the rite in full—our cultured forebear alone.

translations.literal: Benevolent grace broadly extending; generation after generation forever preserved.
translations.idiomatic: Benevolent grace spreads far and wide; generation after generation it is preserved forever.

translations.literal: The ancestral sacrifice at its beginning; thereby exalting filial piety.
translations.idiomatic: At the first of the ancestral rite, filial devotion is proclaimed.

translations.literal: Emperor returning to his seat, 《Ritual Repose》
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor returns to his seat, 《Ritual Repose》

translations.literal: Ears hearing the jade chimes; eyes beholding the luminous pearls.
translations.idiomatic: The ear catches the ring of jade; the eye beholds the glow of luminous pearls.

translations.literal: Music complete with Zhou performance; rites referring to Han diagrams.
translations.idiomatic: Music follows the Zhou pattern; ritual draws on Han precedent.

translations.literal: Spirits and men both present; Heaven and earth in accord.
translations.idiomatic: Gods and men stand present together; Heaven and earth are in harmony.

translations.literal: Having already seen the Lord; the king's heart is then joyful.
translations.idiomatic: Having beheld the Lord, the sovereign's heart is filled with joy.

sentences.zh: 尚書捧俎，《禧安》展牲登俎，《簫韶》在庭。

translations.literal: Ministers of State bearing the sacrificial trays, 《Auspicious Repose》: displaying the victims upon the trays; 《Xiao-Shao》 in the court.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers of State bear the offering-trays, 《Auspicious Repose》: victims are laid upon the trays; 《Xiao-Shao》 sounds in the court.

translations.literal: Offerings displayed in the five chambers; intent penetrating the three numinous powers.
translations.idiomatic: Offerings spread through the five chambers; devotion reaches the three numinous powers.

translations.literal: Not the things themselves are feasted; only sincerity makes fragrance.
translations.idiomatic: It is not the offerings themselves that are feasted upon—only sincerity makes the fragrance rise.

translations.literal: Forever acting as sacrifice master; may the spirits be endlessly at peace.
translations.idiomatic: Forever master of the sacrifice—may the spirits know endless peace.

sentences.zh: 昊天上帝位酌獻，《慶安》日在東陸，維時上辛。

translations.literal: Lord of Heaven Supreme Lord's seat pouring libation, 《Celebratory Repose》: the sun is in the eastern quarter; the time is the upper xin day.
translations.idiomatic: Libation at the Lord of Heaven's place, 《Celebratory Repose》: the sun stands in the eastern quarter—on the upper xin day.

translations.literal: First opening the hall of yang; reverently rites honoring the exalted spirits.
translations.idiomatic: The hall of yang is first opened; with reverence we honor the exalted spirits.

translations.literal: Azure jade gleaming through the night; purple incense glowing at dawn.
translations.idiomatic: Azure jade shines through the night; purple incense glows at dawn.

translations.literal: Ancestors jointly paired; Heaven and earth sharing the burnt offering.
translations.idiomatic: Ancestors stand paired together; Heaven and earth share one burnt offering.

sentences.zh: 皇地祇位酌獻，《彰安》地禩泰折，歌同我將。

translations.literal: Imperial Earth Spirit's seat pouring libation, 《Resplendent Repose》: the earth altar's great autumn sacrifice; the hymn like 'I Will.'
translations.idiomatic: Libation at the Imperial Earth Spirit's place, 《Resplendent Repose》: the earth altar's great autumn rite—the hymn echoes 'I Will.'

translations.literal: Dark victims pure and clean; silk and bamboo sounding forth.
translations.idiomatic: Dark victims, pure and unblemished; strings and pipes rise in song.

translations.literal: Broad, deep, and enduring; encompassing vastness with radiance.
translations.idiomatic: Broad and deep, enduring long—embracing the vast with luminous grace.

translations.literal: Upholding the ancestral altars; saying: deeply never forgotten.
translations.idiomatic: Upholding the altars of state—deeply, never forgotten.

translations.literal: Founding Ancestor's seat pouring libation, 《Filial Repose》
translations.idiomatic: Libation at the Founding Ancestor's seat, 《Filial Repose》

translations.literal: One virtue opening the foundation; a hundred years handing down the lineage.
translations.idiomatic: Single virtue founded the realm; a hundred years of lineage descend.

translations.literal: Central Heaven's di and jiao sacrifices; near the seas, tribute at court.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's di and suburban rites are performed at the center; from the farthest seas, tribute comes to court.

translations.literal: Precious tortoises succeeding one another; vessels and cauldrons growing heavier.
translations.idiomatic: Sacred tortoises pass in succession; ritual vessels and cauldrons grow ever weightier.

translations.literal: Grace deep, celebration extending; the Lord again mandates Song.
translations.idiomatic: Deep is the grace, long the blessing—Heaven renews its mandate to Song.

sentences.zh: 太宗位酌獻，《韶安》紹天承業，繼世立功。

translations.literal: Taizong's seat pouring libation, 《Harmonious Repose》: inheriting Heaven, continuing the enterprise; succeeding generations establishing merit.
translations.idiomatic: Libation at Emperor Taizong's seat, 《Harmonious Repose》: inheriting Heaven's legacy, he carried the enterprise forward—merit won for ages to come.

translations.literal: Within curtains repeated victories; chariots and script at last unified.
translations.idiomatic: Victory after victory was won from the command tent; at last chariots and script were one.

translations.literal: Martial power sweeping away miasma and mist; culture hanging like the sun's rainbow.
translations.idiomatic: Arms swept away the miasma; letters hung like a rainbow across the sun.

translations.literal: The lingering grace reaching everywhere; who knows its end!
translations.idiomatic: The grace he left reaches everywhere—who can know where it ends!

sentences.zh: 徽宗位酌獻，《成安》欽惟合宮，承神至尊。

translations.literal: Huizong's seat pouring libation, 《Fulfilled Repose》: reverently considering the combined hall; receiving the spirit, most supreme.
translations.idiomatic: Libation at Emperor Huizong's seat, 《Fulfilled Repose》: reverently in the unified hall, receiving the supreme spirit.

translations.literal: Reverently vigilant, single in refinement; solemn as if present.
translations.idiomatic: Reverent and wholly intent, solemn as though he were still present.

translations.literal: Setting out this fine cup; orchid and angelica its fragrance.
translations.idiomatic: This fine cup is set forth, fragrant with orchid and angelica.

translations.literal: Sending forth blessing and descending auspice; to sons and to grandsons.
translations.idiomatic: Blessing is sent forth, fortune descends—to sons and grandsons.

sentences.zh: 皇帝還小次，《儀安》匏尊既舉，鞂席未移。

translations.literal: Emperor returning to the inner pavilion, 《Ritual Repose》: gourd goblets already raised; the mat seats not yet shifted.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor returns to the inner rest-pavilion, 《Ritual Repose》: the gourd wine is already raised, yet the mat seats have not yet shifted.

translations.literal: Having virtue, thus looked upon; no spirit not coming.
translations.idiomatic: Virtue draws every gaze; no spirit fails to come.

translations.literal: All things' disposition solemn and grave; the heavenly realm clear and tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: All creation stands solemn and still; heaven is clear and serene.

translations.literal: Dwelling at the center, receiving the mandate; forever restoring the realm's foundation.
translations.idiomatic: Receiving the mandate at the center, the realm's foundation is restored forever.

translations.literal: Civil dance withdrawing, martial dance advancing, 《Solemn Repose》
translations.idiomatic: The civil dancers withdraw, the martial dancers advance, 《Solemn Repose》

sentences.zh: 神之至，慶陰杳冥，風馬雲車，恍若有承。

translations.literal: The spirit's arrival: celebration in deepest shade; wind horses and cloud chariots, as if bearing a response.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit arrives—celebration in deepest shade; wind horses and cloud chariots seem to bear a response.

translations.literal: Fully arraying form, sound, and countenance; oh clear is civilization.
translations.idiomatic: Form, sound, and bearing are fully arrayed—bright shines civilization.

translations.literal: May it approach the fine blessing of Yu and Shun; come to feast, come to peace.
translations.idiomatic: May we approach the blessed age of Yu and Shun—come to feast, come to rest.

sentences.zh: 亞獻，《穆安》四阿有嚴，神既戾止。

translations.literal: Secondary offering, 《Solemn Repose》: the four eaves held stern; the spirit having settled.
translations.idiomatic: Second libation, 《Solemn Repose》: stern stand the four eaves—the spirit has settled here.

translations.literal: Material offerings though numerous in ritual; pure sincerity lies only in oneself.
translations.idiomatic: Though offerings abound in ritual, pure sincerity rests in the heart alone.

translations.literal: Companions coming in ordered array; assisting our glorious rite.
translations.idiomatic: Companions come in stately array, assisting our glorious rite.

translations.literal: Filling the pottery and gourds with libation; thereby completing the pure sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Pottery and gourd vessels are filled with libation—the pure sacrifice is brought to completion.

sentences.zh: 終獻，《穆安》誠一為專，禮三而稱。

translations.literal: Final offering, 《Solemn Repose》: sincerity unified as devotion; the rite thrice repeated earns its name.
translations.idiomatic: Final libation, 《Solemn Repose》: sincerity made one and whole—the rite thrice performed fulfills its name.

translations.literal: Who assists at the state sacrifice?
translations.idiomatic: Who stands beside us at the state rite?

translations.literal: Only those of our same surname.
translations.idiomatic: Only our own clansmen.

translations.literal: Golden strings repeatedly tuned; jade scepters mutually reflected.
translations.idiomatic: Golden strings are tuned again and again; jade scepters gleam one against another.

translations.literal: This is called the glorious completion; blessings come and the spirits listen.
translations.idiomatic: This is the glorious fulfillment—blessings arrive and the spirits attend.

sentences.zh: 皇帝飲福，《胙安》孰謂天遠，至誠則通。

translations.literal: Emperor drinking the blessing, 《Sacrificial Repose》: who says Heaven is far? With utmost sincerity, communication is achieved.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor partakes of the sacred blessing, 《Sacrificial Repose》: who says Heaven is distant? Utmost sincerity opens the way.

translations.literal: Who says the earth is thick? With Heaven it is one.
translations.idiomatic: Who says the earth lies deep below? With Heaven it is one.

translations.literal: Bestow upon us pure blessing; fully achieving great merit.
translations.idiomatic: Grant us pure blessing, that great merit may be fully achieved.

translations.literal: Holding the chart to govern, like the sun at its zenith.
translations.idiomatic: He holds the celestial chart and governs, like the sun at its zenith.

translations.literal: Clearing the dishes, 《Delight Repose》
translations.idiomatic: Withdrawing the offering-trays, 《Delight Repose》

translations.literal: The ritual officer announces rest; flutes and bells fade like clouds departing.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual officer declares the rite at rest; flutes and bells fall silent like clouds dispersing.

translations.literal: The wine and thatch are already removed; the sacrificial meat vessels are now cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Wine and thatch are cleared away; the sacrificial meat stands are withdrawn.

translations.literal: Dark and bright alike without distress; within and without all equally rejoice.
translations.idiomatic: Dark and bright realms alike know no fear; within and without, all rejoice as one.

translations.literal: The rite complete—what then?
translations.idiomatic: When the rite is complete—what does it mean?

translations.literal: Heaven and earth share the same measure.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven and earth keep the same rhythm.

sentences.zh: 送神，《誠安》奕奕宗祀，煌煌禮文。

translations.literal: Sending off the spirits, 《Sincere Repose》: splendid is the ancestral sacrifice; resplendent the ritual texts.
translations.idiomatic: Escorting the spirits away, 《Sincere Repose》: splendid is the ancestral rite; resplendent its ritual order.

translations.literal: The lofty spirits descend; refined intent rises to be heard.
translations.idiomatic: Lofty spirits descend; refined devotion rises to be heard on high.

translations.literal: The glorious rite is finished; suddenly mounting the azure clouds.
translations.idiomatic: The glorious rite is complete—they suddenly mount the azure clouds.

translations.literal: We dare bow before the clear gift; forever clearing the world's miasma.
translations.idiomatic: We bow before the bright gift, that the world's miasma may be cleared forever.

sentences.zh: 望燎，《儀安》載酌載獻，以純以精。

translations.literal: Gazing at the burning offering, 《Ritual Repose》: repeatedly pouring, repeatedly offering; with purity and refinement.
translations.idiomatic: Gazing at the burnt offering, 《Ritual Repose》: libation after libation, offering after offering—in purity and refinement.

translations.literal: Songs passed through the night's recitation; offerings complete for the autumn harvest.
translations.idiomatic: Hymns carry through the night's recitation; offerings stand ready for the autumn harvest.

translations.literal: Returning gratitude to the root reaches its utmost; listening from the humble brings clarity.
translations.idiomatic: Gratitude to the root reaches its height; listening from the lowly brings understanding.

translations.literal: May we store the bright gift; bless all living beings.
translations.idiomatic: May we store Heaven's bright bounty and bless all living beings.

sentences.zh: 望瘞，《儀安》禮協豐融，誠交仿佛。

translations.literal: Gazing at the buried offering, 《Ritual Repose》: the rite harmonizes in abundance and ease; sincerity communes as if in presence.
translations.idiomatic: Gazing at the buried offering, 《Ritual Repose》: the rite flows in rich harmony; sincerity communes as though the spirits were near.

translations.literal: The feudal lords receive the sacrificial flesh; the ancestral rite approaches the burial offering.
translations.idiomatic: The feudal lords receive the sacrificial meat; the ancestral rite draws near the buried offering.

translations.literal: Bestow upon us fine barley and wheat, to prosper the coming year.
translations.idiomatic: Grant us fine barley and wheat, that the coming year may flourish.

translations.literal: Mountains and rivers send forth clouds; Heaven and earth share the same breath.
translations.idiomatic: Clouds rise from mountains and rivers; Heaven and earth breathe as one.

translations.literal: Returning to the great rest-pavilion, 《Restful Repose》
translations.idiomatic: Returning to the great rest-pavilion, 《Restful Repose》

translations.literal: Responding to Heaven with substance; the business finished and concluded.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven is answered in deed; the rite is done and brought to completion.

translations.literal: Felt tables facing the Lord; bamboo halls bowing to the spirits.
translations.idiomatic: Felt tables face the Lord on High; in bamboo halls we bow to the spirits.

translations.literal: Spiritual radiance shines below; harmonizing breath is thus displayed.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit-light shines below; harmonizing qi is displayed in order.

translations.literal: Blessings and emoluments by the myriad; the foundation's design daily renewed.
translations.idiomatic: Blessings and emoluments come by the myriad; the realm's foundation is renewed day by day.

sentences.zh: 紹興、淳熙分命館職定撰十七首降神，《景安》

translations.literal: During Shaoxing and Chunxi, separately commissioned academy officials to compile seventeen pieces for inviting the spirits down, 《Splendid Repose》
translations.idiomatic: In the Shaoxing and Chunxi eras, academy scholars were separately commissioned to compose seventeen hymns for inviting the spirits down, 《Splendid Repose》

sentences.zh: 圜鍾為宮上直房、心，時惟明堂。

translations.literal: Round bell as palace mode: above, Fang and Xin align; the season is the Ming Hall.
translations.idiomatic: With the round bell in palace mode: above, the Heart constellation stands directly in line—the season is the Ming Hall rite.

translations.literal: Paired with Heaven, feasting the kin; ancestral sacrifice has its constant rule.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven is paired and kin are honored; the ancestral rite keeps its fixed order.

translations.literal: Abundant virtue resides in metal; the day is auspicious, the hour is fine.
translations.idiomatic: Supreme virtue dwells in the metal phase; the day is lucky and the hour is right.

translations.literal: Accept our achieved sincerity; come to arrive, come to peace.
translations.idiomatic: Accept our utmost sincerity; come down and grant us peace.

translations.literal: Yellow bell as horn mode
translations.idiomatic: Yellow bell in horn mode

translations.literal: The unified hall's grand rite; metal and shang mark the season.
translations.idiomatic: The unified hall holds its grand rite; metal and the shang pitch mark the season.

translations.literal: Fully completing the glorious rite; gathering and displaying the supreme ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: The glorious rite is fully prepared; the supreme ceremony is gathered and displayed.

translations.literal: Swiftly running in the court; refined intent solemn and reverent.
translations.idiomatic: They hasten into the court; refined devotion, solemn and reverent.

translations.literal: Come to feast on fine offerings; the spirits are at ease.
translations.idiomatic: Come and feast on fine offerings; the spirits take their ease.

sentences.zh: 太簇為徵休德孔昭，靈承上帝。

translations.literal: Great cluster as zhi mode: beautiful virtue greatly bright; the spirit receives the Supreme Lord.
translations.idiomatic: With the great cluster in zhi mode: beautiful virtue shines forth; the spirit receives the Supreme Lord.

translations.literal: Filial piety at its utmost honors kin; solemn pairing at the seat.
translations.idiomatic: Filial devotion reaches its height in honoring kin; solemn pairing is made at the seat.

translations.literal: Fine offerings fragrant; in ritual nothing is lacking.
translations.idiomatic: Fine offerings are fragrant; nothing in the rite is left wanting.

translations.literal: May the spirits come down; feast upon this utmost sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: May the spirits descend and feast upon this utmost sincerity.

sentences.zh: 姑洗為羽霜露既降，孝思奉先。

translations.literal: Gu xian as yu mode: frost and dew already fallen; filial thought serving the ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: With gu xian in yu mode: frost and dew have fallen; filial devotion serves the ancestors.

translations.literal: Ascending and descending before the Supreme Lord; the rite exalted on nine mats.
translations.idiomatic: We ascend and descend before the Supreme Lord; the rite is exalted upon the nine mats.

translations.literal: Fragrant millet and grain; fat sacrificial beasts, red and pure.
translations.idiomatic: Fragrant millet and grain; fat beasts, red and unblemished.

translations.literal: The spirits come and are at ease; in contemplation, solemn stillness.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits come and take their ease; in contemplation all is solemn and still.

sentences.zh: 盥洗，《正安》禮經之重，祭典為宗。

translations.literal: Ritual ablution, 《Proper Repose》: the weight of the ritual classics; sacrificial canon as foundation.
translations.idiomatic: Ablution, 《Proper Repose》: weighty is the ritual canon; the sacrificial code is its foundation.

translations.literal: The senior duke presiding over the rite; in advancing and withdrawing ever more reverent.
translations.idiomatic: The senior duke presides over the rite; in every advance and withdrawal he grows more reverent.

translations.literal: All offerings abundant and pure; the prescribed ceremony solemn and harmonious.
translations.idiomatic: All offerings are abundant and pure; the prescribed ceremony is solemn and harmonious.

translations.literal: A hundred auspices gather and settle; only the auspicious is followed.
translations.idiomatic: A hundred blessings gather here; only what is auspicious is chosen.

translations.literal: Ascending the hall, 《Proper Repose》
translations.idiomatic: Ascending the hall, 《Proper Repose》

translations.literal: The imperial ancestor paired with the Lord; yearly sacrifice at the Ming Hall.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial ancestor is paired with the Lord; each year the Ming Hall rite is performed.

translations.literal: Crown and robes ascending and descending; jade pendants ringing clear.
translations.idiomatic: In crown and robes he ascends and descends; jade pendants chime clearly.

translations.literal: Quick and slow with measure; advancing and stopping in perfect dignity.
translations.idiomatic: Quick and slow keep their measure; every advance and halt is perfectly dignified.

translations.literal: At this time assisting at the feast; day by day pacifying the four directions.
translations.idiomatic: At this hour he assists at the feast; day by day the four quarters are brought to peace.

sentences.zh: 上帝位奠玉幣，《嘉安》大享季秋，百執揚厲。

translations.literal: Supreme Lord's seat presenting jade and silks, 《Fine Repose》: great feast in late autumn; the hundred officers raise their solemnity.
translations.idiomatic: At the Supreme Lord's place, offering jade and silks, 《Fine Repose》: the great autumn feast—every officer lifts his solemn duty.

translations.literal: Bright bright Taizong; majestic majestic Supreme Lord.
translations.idiomatic: Bright shines Taizong; majestic is the Supreme Lord.

translations.literal: Reverently offering sincere devotion; thereby solemnly presenting jade scepters and silks.
translations.idiomatic: Reverently we offer sincere devotion; with solemn care we present jade scepters and silks.

translations.literal: Bless our bright virtue; grant this to coming generations.
translations.idiomatic: Bless our bright virtue; grant this bounty to generations yet to come.

sentences.zh: 太宗位奠幣，《宗安》穆穆皇祖，丕昭聖功。

translations.literal: Taizong's seat offering silks, 《Ancestral Repose》: solemn solemn imperial ancestor; greatly displaying sacred merit.
translations.idiomatic: Silks offered at Taizong's seat, 《Ancestral Repose》: solemn is the imperial ancestor; his sacred merit shines forth.

translations.literal: Sound and measure govern the person; music complete, ritual exalted.
translations.idiomatic: Sound and measure govern the body; music is complete and the rite is exalted.

translations.literal: Reverently offering measured silks; sacrificing at the unified hall.
translations.idiomatic: Reverently we offer measured silks and sacrifice at the unified hall.

translations.literal: Jade and silks from ten thousand states; hearts bearing unity.
translations.idiomatic: Jade and silks from ten thousand states; all hearts bear the same intent.

sentences.zh: 捧俎，《豐安》備物昭陳，工祝告具。

translations.literal: Presenting the sacrificial tray, 《Abundant Repose》: offerings fully displayed in brightness; the ritual officer announces all is ready.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting the sacrificial tray, 《Abundant Repose》: offerings are fully displayed in order; the ritual officer declares all is prepared.

translations.literal: Both sheep and cattle; very fat, very abundant.
translations.idiomatic: Sheep and cattle alike—very fat, very plentiful.

translations.literal: Fine offerings fragrant; added food fit to satisfy.
translations.idiomatic: Fine offerings are fragrant; added food is fit to satisfy.

translations.literal: Gathering the five blessings of the season; forever receiving abundant sacrificial flesh.
translations.idiomatic: The season's five blessings are gathered; may we forever receive abundant sacred bounty.

translations.literal: Supreme Lord's seat pouring libation, 《Fine Repose》
translations.idiomatic: Libation at the Supreme Lord's place, 《Fine Repose》

translations.literal: Blazing are Fang and Xin; bright bright, harmonious union.
translations.idiomatic: Blazing are the Heart stars; bright and harmonious in union.

translations.literal: Only the sage feasts the Lord; the rite performed at the unified hall.
translations.idiomatic: Only the sage may feast the Lord; the rite is performed at the unified hall.

translations.literal: The sacrificial business timely concluded; grain offerings pure and abundant.
translations.idiomatic: The sacrificial rite is timely completed; grain offerings are pure and abundant.

translations.literal: Brightly receiving the renewed mandate; ten thousand blessings all united.
translations.idiomatic: Brightly we receive the renewed mandate; ten thousand blessings are united as one.

sentences.zh: 太宗位酌獻，《德安》受命溥將，勳高百王。

translations.literal: Taizong's seat pouring libation, 《Virtuous Repose》: receiving the mandate broadly and grandly; merit surpassing the hundred kings.
translations.idiomatic: Libation at Taizong's seat, 《Virtuous Repose》: broadly he received the mandate; his merit towers above the hundred kings.

translations.literal: Within the four seas, great settlement; sage governance peaceful and secure.
translations.idiomatic: The realm within the four seas is greatly settled; sage rule brings peace and security.

translations.literal: Solemnly ascending to the paired seat; ancestral sacrifice at the Ming Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Solemnly he ascends to the paired seat; the ancestral rite is held at the Ming Hall.

translations.literal: The spirits and blessings come down; repeatedly bestowing without bound.
translations.idiomatic: Spirits and blessings descend; blessings are bestowed again and again without limit.

sentences.zh: 文舞退、武舞進，《正安》溫厚嚴凝，於皇上帝。

translations.literal: Civil dance withdrawing, martial dance advancing, 《Proper Repose》: warm and generous, stern and gathered; oh august Supreme Lord.
translations.idiomatic: The civil dancers withdraw, the martial dancers advance, 《Proper Repose》: warm and generous, stern and gathered—O august Supreme Lord.

translations.literal: Civil virtue and martial achievement; successive sages jointly paired.
translations.idiomatic: Civil virtue and martial achievement—the successive sages are paired together.

translations.literal: Dance formations image achievement; solemn and harmonious in advancing and withdrawing.
translations.idiomatic: Dance formations image achievement; every advance and withdrawal is solemn and harmonious.

translations.literal: Holding pheasant feathers, steps measured; grasping shields, treading with vigor.
translations.idiomatic: They hold pheasant feathers with measured steps; grasping shields, they tread with martial vigor.

sentences.zh: 亞、終獻，《文安》總章靈承，維國之常。

translations.literal: Secondary and final offerings, 《Civil Repose》: the chief chapter's spirit receives; the constant rule of the state.
translations.idiomatic: Second and final libations, 《Civil Repose》: the chief chapter's spirit receives—the constant rule of the state.

translations.literal: Ritual and music proclaim the fragrant libation; descending and ascending equally dignified.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual and music proclaim the fragrant libation; in descent and ascent all is equally dignified.

translations.literal: Exhausting sincerity and fulfilling intent; offering these repeated cups.
translations.idiomatic: Sincerity is exhausted and intent fulfilled; cup after cup is offered here.

translations.literal: Oh clear and bright above; repeatedly bestowing without bound.
translations.idiomatic: Clear and bright on high—blessings are bestowed again and again without limit.

translations.literal: Clearing the dishes, 《Solemn Repose》
translations.idiomatic: Withdrawing the offering-trays, 《Solemn Repose》

translations.literal: Oh august Supreme Lord; solemnly coming to attend.
translations.idiomatic: O august Supreme Lord—solemnly you come to attend.

translations.literal: Reverently offering fragrant meat stands; thereby reaching the lofty and bright.
translations.idiomatic: Reverently we offer fragrant sacrificial stands, reaching the lofty and bright on high.

translations.literal: Cooking already completed; feasting upon achieved sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: Cooking is complete; the feast is offered in utmost sincerity.

translations.literal: By this granting great blessing; only virtue is fragrant.
translations.idiomatic: By this may great blessing be granted—fragrant is virtue alone.

sentences.zh: 送神，《景安》帝在合宮，鑒觀盛禮。

translations.literal: Sending off the spirits, 《Splendid Repose》: the Lord at the unified hall; observing the grand rite.
translations.idiomatic: Escorting the spirits away, 《Splendid Repose》: the Lord is at the unified hall, witnessing the grand rite.

translations.literal: Millet and grain alone are fragrant; the spirits' hearts then rejoice.
translations.idiomatic: Millet and grain alone are fragrant; the spirits' hearts rejoice.

translations.literal: Ritual complete, music accomplished; already returning to rest.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual is complete and music fulfilled; the rite has already returned to rest.

translations.literal: Myriad myriad years; thereby granting abundant blessing.
translations.idiomatic: For myriad ages may abundant blessing be granted.

sentences.zh: 高宗位奠幣，《宗安》赫赫高廟，於堯有光。

translations.literal: Gaozong's seat offering silks, 《Ancestral Repose》: majestic majestic high temple; with Yao sharing glory.
translations.idiomatic: Silks offered at Gaozong's seat, 《Ancestral Repose》: majestic is the high temple—its glory matches that of Yao.

translations.literal: Covering and spreading through ten thousand sacrifices; crowning glory among the hundred kings.
translations.idiomatic: His grace covers ten thousand rites; he is crowned among the hundred kings.

translations.literal: Measured silks here; pure and clean are presented.
translations.idiomatic: Measured silks are here; pure and clean offerings are presented.

translations.literal: At the Lord's left and right; at this time descending peace.
translations.idiomatic: At the Lord's side—at this hour may peace descend.

sentences.zh: 酌獻，《德安》炎運中興，蒼生載寧。

translations.literal: Pouring libation, 《Virtuous Repose》: the blazing dynasty is restored; the dark-haired people all find peace.
translations.idiomatic: Libation offering, 《Virtuous Repose》: the dynasty's flame rises anew—the people dwell in peace.

translations.literal: Nine decades of ease and pleasure; three reign-periods of abundance and solidity.
translations.idiomatic: Nine decades of ease and delight; three reigns of rich abundance.

translations.literal: With refined sacrifice to the Supreme Lord; ascending to be paired with the august spirits.
translations.idiomatic: With refined rites we sacrifice to the Supreme Lord, ascending to stand beside the august spirits.

translations.literal: Bestowing favored sacrificial blessing; myriad ages inherit inherit.
translations.idiomatic: May favored blessing and sacrificial grace be granted—forever and ever to be inherited.

sentences.zh: 孝宗親享明堂樂曲並同，惟天地位奠幣、酌獻及太祖酌獻、皇帝入小次、還大次、亞獻、送神等篇，各有刪潤。

translations.literal: Xiaozong's personal Ming Hall sacrifice: the music was largely the same, but the sections for Heaven and Earth seats offering silks, pouring libation, and Taizu pouring libation, the Emperor entering the minor pavilion, returning to the great pavilion, secondary offering, and sending off the spirits—each was revised and polished.
translations.idiomatic: For Emperor Xiaozong's personal Ming Hall sacrifice the music was largely unchanged, yet the pieces for offering silks at the Heaven and Earth seats, libation, Taizu's libation, the Emperor's entry into the minor pavilion and return to the great pavilion, the secondary offering, and escorting the spirits away were each revised and polished.

sentences.zh: 又以太祖奠幣曲改名《廣安》，酌獻改名《恭安》，太宗奠幣改名《化安》，酌獻改名《英安》。

translations.literal: Also, Taizu's silk-offering piece was renamed 《Broad Repose》; libation was renamed 《Reverent Repose》; Taizong's silk-offering piece was renamed 《Transformative Repose》; libation was renamed 《Illustrious Repose》.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu's silk-offering hymn was retitled 《Broad Repose》, his libation 《Reverent Repose》; Taizong's silk-offering hymn became 《Transformative Repose》, his libation 《Illustrious Repose》.

sentences.zh: 景德祀皇地祇三首降神，《靜安》至哉厚德，陟配天長！

translations.literal: Jingde era sacrifice to the Imperial Earth Spirit, three pieces for inviting the spirits down, 《Tranquil Repose》: oh how grand the thick virtue; ascending to be paired with Heaven's length!
translations.idiomatic: Three hymns for inviting the spirits down at the Jingde sacrifice to the Imperial Earth Spirit, 《Tranquil Repose》: how boundless that deep virtue—ascending to stand paired with Heaven's enduring span!

translations.literal: Deep and hidden, firm and overcoming; vast and great without boundary.
translations.idiomatic: Deep and still, firm and overcoming—the earth is vast without end.

translations.literal: Sustaining and giving life to the myriad things; divine transformation holding beauty within.
translations.idiomatic: It nourishes every living thing; divine transformation holds its beauty within.

translations.literal: Unified harmony in eight variations; spirits and deities manifest auspicious signs.
translations.idiomatic: Eight variations in harmonious accord—the spirits manifest auspicious signs.

sentences.zh: 奠玉幣，酌獻，《嘉安》於昭祀典，致享坤儀。

translations.literal: Presenting jade and silks, pouring libation, 《Fine Repose》: oh clear is the sacrificial canon; reaching to feast the Earthly Form.
translations.idiomatic: Offering jade and silks, pouring libation, 《Fine Repose》: bright is the sacrificial code—we reach to feast the Earthly Form.

translations.literal: Offerings fully prepared in proper order; the yielding Earth Spirit comes down in response.
translations.idiomatic: Every offering is duly prepared; the yielding Earth Spirit draws near in response.

translations.literal: Merit proclaimed, swiftly establishing; day by day great blessed felicity grows.
translations.idiomatic: Merit is proclaimed and swiftly planted; day by day great blessed fortune grows.

translations.literal: Upholding and bearing every kind; throughout the land all is fit.
translations.idiomatic: It upholds and bears every kind of creature—all under Heaven is as it should be.

translations.literal: Sending off the spirits, 《Tranquil Repose》
translations.idiomatic: Escorting the spirits away, 《Tranquil Repose》

translations.literal: Wondrous use without fixed direction; suddenly coming, suddenly departing.
translations.idiomatic: Wonder works without fixed direction—it comes in an instant and is gone again.

translations.literal: Pure and clean, reverently respectful; thereby completing the burnt and buried offerings.
translations.idiomatic: Pure and clean, reverently dutiful—thus the burnt and buried offerings are brought to completion.

sentences.zh: 景祐夏至祀皇地祇二首

translations.literal: Jingyou era Summer Solstice sacrifice to the Imperial Earth Spirit, two pieces.
translations.idiomatic: Two hymns for the Jingyou Summer Solstice sacrifice to the Imperial Earth Spirit.

translations.literal: (Composed by Emperor Renzong) closing corner bracket〉
translations.idiomatic: (Composed by Emperor Renzong) closing section mark〉

sentences.zh: 太祖奠幣，《恭安》赫矣淳耀，俶載帝基！

translations.literal: Taizu offering silks, 《Reverent Repose》: bright is the pure radiance; beginning to carry the imperial foundation!
translations.idiomatic: Silks offered to Taizu, 《Reverent Repose》: bright is the pure radiance—the imperial foundation begins here!

translations.literal: With one campaign settled; ten thousand states come with ritual propriety.
translations.idiomatic: One campaign brought peace; ten thousand states came in proper ritual order.

translations.literal: Reverently respectful, pure in sacrifice; broad and thick is the Imperial Earth Spirit.
translations.idiomatic: Reverent and pure in sacrifice—the Imperial Earth Spirit is broad and deep.

translations.literal: Majesty and spirit are present there; blessing and emolument thick as thatch.
translations.idiomatic: Majesty and spirit are ever present; blessing and emolument heap high as thatch.

sentences.zh: 酌獻，《英安》丕命惟皇，萬物鹹睹。

translations.literal: Pouring libation, 《Illustrious Repose》: the great mandate belongs to the sovereign; the myriad things all behold.
translations.idiomatic: Libation offering, 《Illustrious Repose》: the great mandate is the sovereign's—all creation looks on.

translations.literal: In reckoning years surpassing Zhou; exalted merit crowning Yu.
translations.idiomatic: In years reckoned beyond Zhou; in merit surpassing even Yu.

translations.literal: Blazing is the fiery essence; greatly flourishing the sage reign.
translations.idiomatic: Blazing is the fiery essence—the sage throne flourishes greatly.

translations.literal: Pouring fragrant libation to pray for the year; forever bestowing abundant blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Fragrant libation is poured to pray for the harvest—may abundant blessing be granted forever.

sentences.zh: 熙寧祀皇地祇十二首迎神，《導安》昭靈積厚，混混坤輿。

translations.literal: Xining era sacrifice to the Imperial Earth Spirit, twelve pieces for inviting the spirits, 《Guiding Repose》: the spirits' brightness accumulates thickness; vast is the earth's carriage.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve hymns for inviting the spirits at the Xining sacrifice to the Imperial Earth Spirit, 《Guiding Repose》: spirit-light gathers in deep fullness—the earth's carriage rolls on without end.

translations.literal: Paired with Heaven as the pole; yin folded in, yang spread out.
translations.idiomatic: Paired with Heaven as the summit—yin is gathered in, yang extends outward.

translations.literal: Pure and bright in presenting the feast; a hundred blessings are stored up.
translations.idiomatic: Pure and bright we present the feast—a hundred blessings are gathered in store.

translations.literal: Perhaps they will come and stop; wind horses and cloud chariots.
translations.idiomatic: May they come and alight—wind horses and cloud chariots.

sentences.zh: 升降，《靖安》有來穆穆，臨此方丘。

translations.literal: Ascending and descending, 《Serene Repose》: they come solemnly; arriving at this square mound.
translations.idiomatic: Ascent and descent, 《Serene Repose》: they come in solemn grace, arriving at this square mound.

translations.literal: When they move, the wind stirs; when they stop, the thunder withdraws.
translations.idiomatic: When they move the wind stirs; when they stop the thunder falls silent.

translations.literal: Personally serving without slackening; abundant offerings, pure delicacies.
translations.idiomatic: Personally we serve without slackening—abundant, pure delicacies are offered.

translations.literal: A hundred prosperities all multiply; indeed is the spirits' rest!
translations.idiomatic: Every kind of prosperity flourishes—indeed the spirits are pleased!

translations.literal: Offering silks, 《Rectifying Repose》
translations.idiomatic: Offering silks, 《Rectifying Repose》

translations.literal: Pure sincerity brightly merged; fragrant and beautiful, fine offerings.
translations.idiomatic: Pure sincerity shines forth in brightness—fragrant, fine offerings are presented.

translations.literal: Solemnly bringing the two essences; with feasting and with offering.
translations.idiomatic: Solemnly we bring the two essences—to feast them and to offer to them.

translations.literal: Splendid light fills the four quarters; spirits and earth-deities come to feast.
translations.idiomatic: Splendid light fills every quarter—the spirits and earth-deities come to feast.

translations.literal: That auspicious sign—what is it?
translations.idiomatic: What is that auspicious sign?

translations.literal: Forever granting favored blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Favored blessing granted for all ages.

sentences.zh: 太祖，《肇安》於皇烈祖，維帝所興。

translations.literal: Taizu, 《Founding Repose》: oh imperial founding ancestor; what the Lord raised up.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu, 《Founding Repose》: O imperial founding ancestor—the Lord's own rising.

translations.literal: Glory to the ancestral sacrifice; like the sun's ascent.
translations.idiomatic: Glory fills the ancestral rite—it rises like the sun.

translations.literal: Proclaiming to the spirits to serve as paired seat; filial feasting abundant abundant.
translations.idiomatic: We proclaim to the spirits to take the paired seat—filial offerings flow in abundance.

translations.literal: Bestowing this blessing and fortune; a hundred generations shall inherit.
translations.idiomatic: May this blessing and fortune be granted—a hundred generations shall inherit it.

sentences.zh: 司徒奉俎，《承安》我修祀事，於何致誠？

translations.literal: Minister of Education presenting the sacrificial tray, 《Sustaining Repose》: we perform the sacrificial rite—by what do we achieve sincerity?
translations.idiomatic: The Minister of Education presents the sacrificial tray, 《Sustaining Repose》: we perform the sacrificial rite—how may sincerity be fully achieved?

translations.literal: None dare be slack or idle; regarding these fat sacrificial animals.
translations.idiomatic: No one dares be slack or idle—we look upon these fat sacrificial victims.

translations.literal: Receiving them cooked and presenting on the tray; assisting with harmonious sounds.
translations.idiomatic: They are cooked and placed upon the tray, assisted by harmonious music.

translations.literal: Come down, oh splendid response; generation after generation aiding the imperial brightness.
translations.idiomatic: Come down in splendid response—may every generation uphold the imperial brightness.

sentences.zh: 酌獻，《和安》猗嗟富媼，博厚含弘。

translations.literal: Pouring libation, 《Harmonious Repose》: ah, the fertile Grand Matron; broad and thick, all-encompassing.
translations.idiomatic: Libation offering, 《Harmonious Repose》: ah, the fertile Grand Matron—broad, deep, and all-embracing.

translations.literal: Sending forth glory and spreading beauty; moving and planted things here abundant.
translations.idiomatic: Glory spreads and beauty unfolds—every creature and plant here flourishes.

translations.literal: Here we pour this wine; intercourse and communion.
translations.idiomatic: Here we pour this wine—in communion we join.

translations.literal: Multitudes of auspicious signs gather and stop; bestowing protection without end.
translations.idiomatic: All auspicious signs gather here—protection descends without end.

translations.literal: Taizu, 《Assisting Repose》
translations.idiomatic: Taizu, 《Assisting Repose》

translations.literal: Broad radiance all-encompassing; the power of the Earthly Origin.
translations.idiomatic: Broad radiance, all-embracing—the power of the Earthly Origin.

translations.literal: Seas and territories all peaceful; the Founding Ancestor's virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Seas and territories know peace—the Founding Ancestor's virtue.

translations.literal: Serving as paired seat at the altar; neither overstepping nor erring.
translations.idiomatic: Paired at the altar he takes his place—without overstepping or fault.

translations.literal: May descendants inherit; do not replace that standard.
translations.idiomatic: May descendants inherit it—let that standard never lapse.

sentences.zh: 飲福，《禔安》載登壇阼，載酌尊彝。

translations.literal: Drinking the blessing, 《Blessing Repose》: repeatedly ascending the altar steps; repeatedly pouring from the honored vessels.
translations.idiomatic: Partaking of the sacred blessing, 《Blessing Repose》: again and again he ascends the altar steps, again and again pours from the honored vessels.

translations.literal: Sacrificial animals and wine of fine flavor; blessing and emolument purely glorious.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrificial victims and wine of fine savor—blessing and emolument purely radiant.

translations.literal: That blessing—what is it?
translations.idiomatic: What is that blessing?

translations.literal: The myriad things all fit.
translations.idiomatic: Every creature thrives as it should.

translations.literal: That emolument—what is it?
translations.idiomatic: What is that emolument?

translations.literal: Forever inheriting the spirits' blessed felicity.
translations.idiomatic: Forever to inherit the spirits' blessed felicity.

sentences.zh: 退文舞、迎武舞，《威安》雍雍肅肅，建我采旄。

translations.literal: Retiring civil dance, welcoming martial dance, 《Martial Repose》: harmonious harmonious, solemn solemn; raising our colored banners.
translations.idiomatic: The civil dancers withdraw, the martial dancers advance, 《Martial Repose》: harmonious and solemn—we raise our colored banners.

translations.literal: Dancing with jade axes; neither boisterous nor arrogant.
translations.idiomatic: They dance with jade axes—neither rowdy nor proud.

translations.literal: Presenting and displaying; spleen and cheek fine delicacies.
translations.idiomatic: The trays are set and the feast spread out—spleen and cheek, fine delicacies.

translations.literal: By what to assist the music?
translations.idiomatic: With what shall the music be assisted?

translations.literal: Bells, drums, pipes, and flutes.
translations.idiomatic: Bells, drums, pipes, and flutes.

sentences.zh: 亞、終獻，《儀安》折俎在籩，胾羹在豆。

translations.literal: Secondary and final offerings, 《Ritual Repose》: minced meat on the stands, chopped soup in the bowls.
translations.idiomatic: Second and final libations, 《Ritual Repose》: minced meat on the stands, chopped stew in the bowls.

translations.literal: By what to pour it?
translations.idiomatic: With what shall it be poured?

translations.literal: Wine and sweet liquor are the assist.
translations.idiomatic: Wine and sweet liquor assist the rite.

translations.literal: By what to bestow it?
translations.idiomatic: With what shall it be granted?

translations.literal: Leave you long life.
translations.idiomatic: May long life be granted to you.

translations.literal: By what to summon it down?
translations.idiomatic: By what shall it be made to descend?

translations.literal: Forever your peace and abundance.
translations.idiomatic: May you enjoy peace and abundance forever.

translations.literal: Clearing the dishes, 《Abundant Repose》
translations.idiomatic: Withdrawing the offering-trays, 《Abundant Repose》

translations.literal: Trailing our embroidered robes; shoes and sandals in matched steps.
translations.idiomatic: Our embroidered robes trail behind—shoes and sandals step in rhythm.

translations.literal: Ringing our pendants and jade; descending and ascending steadily.
translations.idiomatic: Our pendants and jade chime softly—ascent and descent proceed in steady order.

translations.literal: When we present and display—already we say there is no disrespect.
