translations.idiomatic: When we set out the feast—we declare that no disrespect is shown.

translations.literal: When at last we clear away—reverent respect is the guiding principle.
translations.idiomatic: When the trays are at last withdrawn—reverent respect is our sole guide.

sentences.zh: 送神，《阜安》神兮來下，享此芬。

translations.literal: Sending off the spirits, 《Luxuriant Repose》: oh spirits, you came down; feast upon this fragrance.
translations.idiomatic: Escorting the spirits away, 《Luxuriant Repose》: O spirits, you came down—feast upon this fragrance.

translations.literal: Pouring libation harmoniously; the officiants most diligent.
translations.idiomatic: Libation is poured in solemn harmony—the officiants are utterly diligent.

translations.literal: The spirits have returned; suddenly mounting the flying clouds.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits have returned—they suddenly mount the flying clouds.

translations.literal: Leaving us auspicious blessing; every object rejoicing rejoicing.
translations.idiomatic: They leave us auspicious blessing—every sign of nature rejoices.

sentences.zh: 常祀皇地祇五首迎神，《寧安》

translations.literal: Regular sacrifice to the Imperial Earth Spirit, five pieces for inviting the spirits, 《Peaceful Repose》
translations.idiomatic: Five hymns for inviting the spirits at the regular sacrifice to the Imperial Earth Spirit, 《Peaceful Repose》

translations.literal: (Eight Variations) closing corner bracket〉
translations.idiomatic: (Eight Variations) closing section mark〉

translations.literal: The virtue of the Earthly Origin; broad radiance without boundary.
translations.idiomatic: The virtue of the Earthly Origin—broad radiance without end.

translations.literal: One qi mutually interacting; a hundred things abundant and flourishing.
translations.idiomatic: One vital force interacts within it—a hundred things flourish in abundance.

translations.literal: Auspiciously purified, presenting the feast; refined brightness is the offering.
translations.idiomatic: Auspiciously purified we present the feast—refined brightness is our offering.

translations.literal: By this granting great blessing; the tripod reign spiritually enduring.
translations.idiomatic: By this may great blessing be granted—the dynasty's fortune endure in spiritual splendor.

sentences.zh: 升降，《正安》禮經之重，祭典為宗。

translations.literal: Ascending and descending, 《Proper Repose》: the weight of the ritual classics; sacrificial canon as foundation.
translations.idiomatic: Ascent and descent, 《Proper Repose》: weighty is the ritual canon; the sacrificial code is its foundation.

translations.literal: The senior duke presiding over the rite; in ascending and descending ever more reverent.
translations.idiomatic: The senior duke presides over the rite; in every ascent and descent he grows more reverent.

translations.literal: All offerings abundant and pure; fine ritual solemn and harmonious.
translations.idiomatic: Every offering is abundant and pure—the fine rite is solemn and harmonious.

translations.literal: A hundred auspicious signs gather and stop; only the auspicious is followed.
translations.idiomatic: A hundred blessings gather here; only what is auspicious is chosen.

sentences.zh: 奉俎，《豐安》禮崇禋祀，神鑒孔明。

translations.literal: Presenting the sacrificial tray, 《Abundant Repose》: the rite exalts the burnt offering; the spirits observe with clear brightness.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting the sacrificial tray, 《Abundant Repose》: the burnt offering rite is exalted—the spirits observe with clear brightness.

translations.literal: Sacrificial bulls fat and plump; by roasting and by boiling.
translations.idiomatic: Fat sacrificial bulls, plump and full—roasted and boiled.

translations.literal: Fragrant aroma pure and clean; every thing only refined.
translations.idiomatic: Fragrant and pure is the aroma—every offering is refined.

translations.literal: Bestowing pure great blessing; feasting upon this utmost sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: May pure blessing be granted—we feast upon this utmost sincerity.

translations.literal: Retiring civil dance, welcoming martial dance, 《Martial Repose》
translations.idiomatic: The civil dancers withdraw, the martial dancers advance, 《Martial Repose》

translations.literal: Advancing in rank, retiring in rank; bearing up shields, raising shields.
translations.idiomatic: They advance in rank and retire in rank—bearing shields high, raising them again.

translations.literal: Not erring in ritual; bearing and dress have pattern.
translations.idiomatic: Without fault in the rite—their bearing and attire are perfectly ordered.

translations.literal: In manner soothing, in manner assisting; the spirit protector is the one who hears.
translations.idiomatic: Soothing and assisting—may the protecting spirit hear and heed.

translations.literal: Drumming them, dancing them; the spirits forever peacefully at rest.
translations.idiomatic: With drum and dance—the spirits dwell in everlasting peace and rest.

sentences.zh: 送神，《寧安》物備百嘉，樂周八變。

translations.literal: Sending off the spirits, 《Peaceful Repose》: things prepared, a hundred blessings; music circling the Eight Variations.
translations.idiomatic: Escorting the spirits away, 《Peaceful Repose》: every good thing is prepared—the music circles through the Eight Variations.

translations.literal: With sincerity is the feast; bright virtue is the offering.
translations.idiomatic: With perfect sincerity we feast—bright virtue is what we offer.

translations.literal: The spirits' scrutiny clearly revealed; abundant blessed felicity bestowed in favor.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits' gaze shines clear—abundant blessed fortune is granted in favor.

translations.literal: Turning the reins, drifting away; distant, not to be seen.
translations.idiomatic: They turn their reins and drift away—far off, beyond all sight.

sentences.zh: 紹興祀皇地祇十五首迎神，《寧安》函鍾為宮

translations.literal: Shaoxing sacrifice to the Imperial Earth Spirit, fifteen pieces for inviting the spirits, 《Peaceful Repose》; Encased Bell as keynote.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteen hymns for inviting the spirits at the Shaoxing sacrifice to the Imperial Earth Spirit, 《Peaceful Repose》, with Encased Bell as keynote.

translations.literal: Oh how grand the thick virtue; the myriad things by it are sustained!
translations.idiomatic: How boundless that deep virtue—all living things are nourished by it!

translations.literal: Straight and square is the standard; gathering and opening each is fitting.
translations.idiomatic: Straight and square is its law—gathering and opening, each in its season.

translations.literal: Oh clear is the sacrificial canon; reaching to feast the Earthly Form.
translations.idiomatic: Bright is the sacrificial code—we reach to feast the Earthly Form.

translations.literal: In ritual none goes unanswered; the spirits come down in response.
translations.idiomatic: No rite goes unanswered—the spirits draw near in response.

sentences.zh: 太簇為角蕆事方丘，舊典時式。

translations.literal: Great Cluster as jue: completing the rite at the Square Mound, the old canon in season.
translations.idiomatic: With Great Cluster as jue—completing the rite at the Square Mound, the ancient canon in its season.

translations.literal: Utmost sincerity moves the spirits; fragrance is not millet and sacrificial grain alone.
translations.idiomatic: Utmost sincerity moves the spirits—fragrance lies not in millet and grain alone.

translations.literal: With harmonious warmth they come; scrutinizing this bright virtue.
translations.idiomatic: With warm response they draw near—gazing upon this bright virtue.

translations.literal: Forever bestowing Earth's treasures; in season ten thousand, in season a hundred million.
translations.idiomatic: May Earth's treasures be granted forever—ten thousandfold, hundred-millionfold in season.

sentences.zh: 姑洗為徵至哉坤元，乃順承天。

translations.literal: Maiden Wash as zhi: oh how grand the Earthly Origin; thus obediently receiving Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: With Maiden Wash as zhi—how grand the Earthly Origin, obediently receiving Heaven!

translations.literal: Thick virtue bears the myriad things; embracing vastness in the eight borderlands.
translations.idiomatic: Deep virtue bears every thing—embracing all vastness to the eight horizons.

translations.literal: The sun in the north brings much heat; the sacrificial rite auspiciously purified.
translations.idiomatic: When the sun stands north and heat abounds—the rite is auspiciously purified.

translations.literal: In manner making clear there is no affliction; daring to declare reverent devotion.
translations.idiomatic: We make clear that all is well—and declare our reverent devotion.

sentences.zh: 南呂為羽蕆事方丘，情文孔時。

translations.literal: Southern Pitch-pipe as yu: completing the rite at the Square Mound; sentiment and form perfectly timed.
translations.idiomatic: With Southern Pitch-pipe as yu—completing the rite at the Square Mound, feeling and form perfectly timed.

translations.literal: Famous mountains and great marshes; assisting sacrifice none left out.
translations.idiomatic: Every famous mountain and great marsh—none omitted from the assisting sacrifice.

translations.literal: Victims displayed, dark calves; music prepared, 《Salt Pool》.
translations.idiomatic: Dark calves are set forth as offerings—the music of 《Salt Pool》 stands ready.

translations.literal: The yielding Earth Spirits all come forth; granting us abundant blessed felicity.
translations.idiomatic: The yielding Earth Spirits all draw near—granting us abundant blessed fortune.

translations.literal: Ritual ablution, 《Proper Repose》
translations.idiomatic: Ablution, 《Proper Repose》

translations.literal: Oh solemn the grand rite; solemn solemn in the hall.
translations.idiomatic: How solemn the grand rite—grave and ordered within the hall.

translations.literal: Completing the rite has its beginning; straight at the eastern wing.
translations.idiomatic: The rite begins its completion—proceeding straight to the eastern wing.

translations.literal: Washing and cleansing this careful; only reverent, only pure.
translations.idiomatic: Washing and cleansing with utmost care—reverent and pure in every step.

translations.literal: Reverently offering yielding fineness; feasting upon this perfect sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: Reverently we offer what is gentle and fine—we feast upon this perfect sincerity.

sentences.zh: 升殿，《正安》景風應時，聿嚴毖祀。

translations.literal: Ascending the hall, 《Proper Repose》: the fair wind responds to the season; thereby solemn is the refined sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending the hall, 《Proper Repose》: the fair wind answers the season—as we solemnly perform the refined sacrifice.

translations.literal: Performing the rite at the Square Mound; resounding resounding, numerous numerous.
translations.idiomatic: Performing the rite at the Square Mound—resounding and orderly in full array.

translations.literal: Ascending and descending have measure; three offerings complete the rite.
translations.idiomatic: Ascent and descent keep perfect measure—the three offerings complete the rite.

translations.literal: May the spirits come down; bestow upon us abundant blessing.
translations.idiomatic: May the spirits descend and grant us abundant blessing.

sentences.zh: 正位奠玉幣，《嘉安》坤元博厚，對越天明。

translations.literal: At the principal seat presenting jade and silks, 《Fine Repose》: the Earthly Origin broad and thick; facing and answering Heaven's brightness.
translations.idiomatic: At the principal seat, offering jade and silks, 《Fine Repose》: the Earthly Origin is broad and deep—we face Heaven's bright presence.

translations.literal: Extending the rite at the Square Marsh; truly only looking to delight.
translations.idiomatic: We extend the rite at the Square Marsh—looking wholly to win acceptance and delight.

translations.literal: Fine jade measured silks; reverently offering pure refinement.
translations.idiomatic: Fine jade and measured silks—we reverently offer pure refinement.

translations.literal: Bestow upon us abundant blessing; reaching all contained life.
translations.idiomatic: Grant us abundant blessing—reaching every living thing under Heaven.

sentences.zh: 太祖位奠幣，《定安》毖祀泰折，柔祇是承。

translations.literal: Founding Ancestor's seat offering silks, 《Settled Repose》: refined sacrifice at the grand mound; the yielding Earth Spirit is received.
translations.idiomatic: Silks offered at the Founding Ancestor's seat, 《Settled Repose》: at the grand mound the refined sacrifice is performed—the yielding Earth Spirit is honored.

translations.literal: Oh splendid the Founding Ancestor; the Way reaches the Three Spirits.
translations.idiomatic: O splendid Founding Ancestor—your Way reaches the Three Spirits.

translations.literal: In manner solemn the secondary pairing; thick virtue only peaceful.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn is the secondary pairing—deep virtue alone brings peace.

translations.literal: Thereby making clear the offering of silks; feasting upon perfect sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: We clearly present our silks—we feast upon perfect sincerity.

translations.literal: Presenting the sacrificial tray, 《Abundant Repose》
translations.idiomatic: Presenting the sacrificial tray, 《Abundant Repose》

sentences.zh: 丕答靈貺，蕆事方丘，豆登在列，鼎俎斯儔。

translations.literal: Greatly answering the spirits' gift; completing the rite at the Square Mound—bowls and stands arrayed in rows, tripods and trays thus matched.
translations.idiomatic: Greatly answering the spirits' bounty—we complete the rite at the Square Mound: bowls and stands set in rows, tripods and trays duly matched.

translations.literal: Sacrificial bulls announced all ready; reverent awe filling all around.
translations.idiomatic: The sacrificial bulls are declared ready—reverent awe suffuses every part.

translations.literal: The yielding Earth Spirit clearly comes down; whirlwind arrives, clouds flow.
translations.idiomatic: The yielding Earth Spirit draws clearly near—whirlwinds rise and clouds stream forth.

sentences.zh: 正位酌獻，《光安》祗事坤元，飭躬敢憚！

translations.literal: At the principal seat pouring libation, 《Radiant Repose》: reverently serving the Earthly Origin; disciplining the body, daring to shrink!
translations.idiomatic: At the principal seat, pouring libation, 《Radiant Repose》: reverently we serve the Earthly Origin—how dare we slacken in body or mind!

translations.literal: Thereby purifying the sacrificial grain; bearing the solemn jade scepter and libation cup.
translations.idiomatic: The sacrificial grain is purified—we bear the solemn jade scepter and libation cup.

translations.literal: Clear brightness inwardly merged; fine savor outwardly radiant.
translations.idiomatic: Clarity and brightness merge within—fine savor shines without.

translations.literal: Granting us abundant blessing; in season a hundred million, in season ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Grant us abundant blessing—ten thousandfold, hundred-millionfold in season.

sentences.zh: 太祖位酌獻，《英安》皇矣藝祖，九圍是式！

translations.literal: Founding Ancestor's seat pouring libation, 《Illustrious Repose》: august is the Founding Ancestor; the nine domains take him as model!
translations.idiomatic: Libation at the Founding Ancestor's seat, 《Illustrious Repose》: august is the Founding Ancestor—all nine domains take him as their model!

translations.literal: Oh how grand the yielding Earth Spirit; the myriad kinds all duly grow.
translations.idiomatic: How grand the yielding Earth Spirit—every kind of creature flourishes in its season.

translations.literal: Protecting this fine state; granting us millet and sacrificial grain.
translations.idiomatic: Protect this blessed realm—grant us millet and grain.

translations.literal: Pouring fragrant libation, declaring devotion; as secondary pairing without limit.
translations.idiomatic: With fragrant libation we declare our devotion—paired without end as secondary host.

sentences.zh: 文舞退、武舞進，《正安》於穆媼神，媲德彼天。

translations.literal: Civil dance withdrawing, martial dance advancing, 《Proper Repose》: oh solemn the Earth Mother Spirit; matching virtue with that Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The civil dancers withdraw, the martial dancers advance, 《Proper Repose》: O solemn Earth Mother Spirit—your virtue matches Heaven above.

translations.literal: We perform the refined sacrifice; thereby none is not reverent.
translations.idiomatic: We perform the refined sacrifice—in every detail, none but reverent.

translations.literal: Fully displaying the season's grandeur; shields and plumes mutually proclaiming.
translations.idiomatic: The season's grand dance is fully displayed—shields and plumes proclaiming in harmony.

translations.literal: May the spirits come to visit; descending blessing endlessly continuous.
translations.idiomatic: May the spirits come and wander here—blessing descending without end.

translations.literal: Secondary and final offerings, 《Civil Repose》
translations.idiomatic: Second and final libations, 《Civil Repose》

translations.literal: In ritual there is prayer and response; the state has only the canonical constant.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual holds prayer and response—the state has only its canonical law.

translations.literal: Stands and bowls abundant and pure; ascending and descending equally solemn.
translations.idiomatic: Stands and bowls are abundant and pure—ascent and descent are equally solemn.

translations.literal: Offerings prepared, intent conveyed; in manner offering repeated libations.
translations.idiomatic: Every offering is prepared, intent made clear—we offer libation upon libation.

translations.literal: Clearly coming down to feast; from Heaven descending peace.
translations.idiomatic: They clearly descend to feast—peace comes down from Heaven.

sentences.zh: 徹豆，《娛安》承天效法，其道貴誠。

translations.literal: Clearing the dishes, 《Delightful Repose》: receiving Heaven, imitating its law; its Way values sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: Withdrawing the offering-trays, 《Delightful Repose》: receiving Heaven and emulating its Way—the Way values sincerity above all.

translations.literal: Victims offering yellow calves; offering virtue's fragrance.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow calves are offered as sacrifice—the fragrance of virtue is presented.

translations.literal: Fragrant trays announced complete; rite prepared, music full.
translations.idiomatic: The fragrant trays are declared complete—the rite is ready and the music overflowing.

translations.literal: Already still, already at peace; the myriad things moistened into life.
translations.idiomatic: All is still and at peace—every living thing is nourished into life.

sentences.zh: 送神，《寧安》至厚至深，其動也剛。

translations.literal: Sending off the spirits, 《Peaceful Repose》: utmost thick, utmost deep; in movement, firm.
translations.idiomatic: Escorting the spirits away, 《Peaceful Repose》: deepest and most profound—in movement, firm and strong.

translations.literal: Refined sincerity silently penetrating; sometimes emerging from its hiding.
translations.idiomatic: Refined sincerity silently penetrates—sometimes breaking forth from hiding.

translations.literal: The spirits' words returning; transformation thereby has brightness.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits take their words and return—transformation thereby gains brightness.

translations.literal: Assisting our blazing dynasty; myriad ages without boundary.
translations.idiomatic: Assist our blazing dynasty—forever without end.

sentences.zh: 宋初祀神州地祇三首降神，《靜安》膴々郊原，茫茫宇縣。

translations.literal: Early Song sacrifice to the Spirit of the Land of the Realm, three pieces for inviting the spirits down, 《Tranquil Repose》: luxuriant luxuriant the suburban plains; vast vast the counties of the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Three hymns for inviting the spirits down at the early Song sacrifice to the Spirit of the Land of the Realm, 《Tranquil Repose》: lush are the suburban plains—vast stretches the realm's domain.

translations.literal: Drawing the wilds, dividing the boundaries; Yu's merit broadly laid out.
translations.idiomatic: The wilds are traced and boundaries divided—Yu the Great's work broadly established.

translations.literal: Spirits and Earth Spirits thus arrive; bowls and stands reverently offered.
translations.idiomatic: Spirits and Earth Spirits draw near—bowls and stands are reverently offered.

translations.literal: Darkly assisting the imperial chart; looking upon it, not to be seen.
translations.idiomatic: In secret they bless the imperial destiny—look as you will, they cannot be seen.

sentences.zh: 奠玉幣，酌獻，《嘉安》蚃儲靈，肅恭用幣。

translations.literal: Presenting jade and silks, pouring libation, 《Fine Repose》: harmonious warmth storing the spirit; solemn respectful use of silks.
translations.idiomatic: Offering jade and silks, pouring libation, 《Fine Repose》: with warm harmony the spirit is stored—we use our silks with solemn reverence.

translations.literal: Resounding vast, guiding harmony; great blessing truly aligned.
translations.idiomatic: Resounding and vast, harmony is guided—great blessing is truly aligned.

translations.literal: Auspicious qi clouds rising; reaching the descendants of Hua.
translations.idiomatic: Auspicious vapor rises like clouds—reaching all the descendants of Hua.

translations.literal: In manner offering Earth's treasures; thereby matching the bright age.
translations.idiomatic: We offer Earth's treasures—thereby matching this bright age.

translations.literal: Sending off the spirits, 《Tranquil Repose》
translations.idiomatic: Escorting the spirits away, 《Tranquil Repose》

translations.literal: Offerings and libations like clouds complete; pure great blessing abundantly continuous.
translations.idiomatic: Offerings and libations are complete as clouds—pure blessing flows in abundance.

translations.literal: August spirits stored in function; distant—whither do they go?
translations.idiomatic: The august spirits withdraw their power—how far away have they gone?

sentences.zh: 景祐孟冬祭神州地祇二首太宗位奠幣，《化安》削平偽邦，嗣興鴻業。

translations.literal: Jingyou era mid-winter sacrifice to the Spirit of the Land of the Realm, two pieces; Taizong's seat offering silks, 《Transformative Repose》: cutting down and leveling the false states; succeeding and raising the grand enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: Two hymns for the Jingyou mid-winter sacrifice to the Spirit of the Land of the Realm; silks offered at Taizong's seat, 《Transformative Repose》: the false states were overthrown and leveled—the grand enterprise was raised and continued.

translations.literal: Ritual and music mutually cultivated; humaneness and virtue fully harmonized.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual and music are jointly perfected—humaneness and virtue fully harmonized.

translations.literal: The yielding Earth Spirit offering and feasting; measured silks thereby received.
translations.idiomatic: The yielding Earth Spirit is offered and feasted—measured silks duly presented.

translations.literal: Secondary seat extending the spirits; the spirits' blessing truly answered.
translations.idiomatic: At the secondary seat the spirits are summoned—their blessing is truly granted in answer.

sentences.zh: 酌獻，《韶安》有煒彌文，克隆宏構。

translations.literal: Pouring libation, 《Shao Repose》: having splendor more abundant in culture; greatly continuing the grand structure.
translations.idiomatic: Libation offering, 《Shao Repose》: splendor and culture abound—the grand structure is greatly continued.

translations.literal: Bequeathing this tranquil counsel; fully receiving abundant blessing.
translations.idiomatic: This tranquil counsel is bequeathed—we fully receive abundant blessing.

translations.literal: Xiè pitch-pipe blowing the reed; the ritual vessel offering wine.
translations.idiomatic: The Xiè pitch-pipe sounds upon the reed—the ritual vessel presents the wine.

translations.literal: Assisting thus deep and hidden; forever praying for lush abundance.
translations.idiomatic: May it assist what is deep and hidden—we ever pray for lush abundance.

sentences.zh: 元符祭神州地祇二首迎神，《寧安》

translations.literal: Yuanfu sacrifice to the Spirit of the Land of the Realm, two pieces for inviting the spirits, 《Peaceful Repose》
translations.idiomatic: Two hymns for inviting the spirits at the Yuanfu sacrifice to the Spirit of the Land of the Realm, 《Peaceful Repose》

translations.literal: (Eight Variations) closing corner bracket〉
translations.idiomatic: (Eight Variations) closing section mark〉

translations.literal: Luxuriant luxuriant the deep realm; August Heaven is its dwelling.
translations.idiomatic: Lush and deep is the realm—August Heaven is its dwelling.

translations.literal: Surely there is hidden assistance; perceptive, bright, upright, and correct.
translations.idiomatic: Surely hidden powers lend their aid—perceptive, bright, upright, and true.

translations.literal: Arraying the stands and bowls; striking and examining metal and stone.
translations.idiomatic: Stands and bowls are set in array—metal and stone instruments are struck.

translations.literal: Within and without tranquil and peaceful; it is the spirits' power.
translations.idiomatic: Within and without, all is tranquil and at peace—by the spirits' power alone.

sentences.zh: 送神，《寧安》都邑浩穰，民物富盛。

translations.literal: Sending off the spirits, 《Peaceful Repose》: capitals and towns vast and teeming; people and things rich and flourishing.
translations.idiomatic: Escorting the spirits away, 《Peaceful Repose》: capitals and towns teem in abundance—the people and all things flourish in wealth.

translations.literal: Host with spirits and Earth Spirits; manifest then great response.
translations.idiomatic: With spirits and Earth Spirits as host—a great response is made manifest.

translations.literal: Jade and silks, victims and perfect oxen; drums, bells, pipes, and chime-stones.
translations.idiomatic: Jade and silks, sacrificial victims and perfect oxen—drums, bells, pipes, and chime-stones.

translations.literal: Earth Spirits offered, thereby delighted; returning to utmost stillness.
translations.idiomatic: The Earth Spirits are offered and thereby delighted—all returns to deepest stillness.

sentences.zh: 紹興祀神州地祇十六首

translations.literal: Shaoxing sacrifice to the Spirit of the Land of the Realm, sixteen pieces
translations.idiomatic: Sixteen hymns for the Shaoxing sacrifice to the Spirit of the Land of the Realm

sentences.zh: 迎神，《寧安》函鍾為宮芒芒下土，恢恢方儀。

translations.literal: Inviting the spirits, 《Peaceful Repose》; Encased Bell as keynote: vast vast the lower earth; expansive expansive the square measure.
translations.idiomatic: Inviting the spirits, 《Peaceful Repose》, with Encased Bell as keynote: vast is the lower earth—expansive is the square measure of the realm.

translations.literal: The rich Earth Mother governs and holds; secretly operating the eight dimensions.
translations.idiomatic: The rich Earth Mother governs and holds—all eight dimensions move in secret.

translations.literal: Thereupon declaring the primal sacrifice; announcing readiness at the auspicious hour.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the primal sacrifice is declared—readiness is announced at the auspicious hour.

translations.literal: Lifting this reverent devotion; may they come down in response.
translations.idiomatic: We lift up this reverent devotion—may the spirits descend in answer.

sentences.zh: 太簇為角洪惟坤元，道著品物。

translations.literal: Grand Cluster as horn pitch: grand is the Earthly Origin; the Way manifests in all kinds of things.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Cluster as horn pitch: grand is the Earthly Origin—the Way manifests in every kind of thing.

translations.literal: Above paired with purple Heaven; thickly bearing its virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Paired above with purple Heaven—it thickly bears its virtue.

translations.literal: The fine month begins the completion; sacrificial vessels arrayed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fine month the rite begins its completion—sacrificial vessels are set in array.

translations.literal: Surely first the Imperial Earth Spirit, to welcome splendid blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Surely the Imperial Earth Spirit comes first—to welcome splendid blessing.

translations.literal: Maiden Wash as zhi pitch
translations.idiomatic: Maiden Wash as zhi pitch

translations.literal: Vast and boundless without limit; surging and immeasurable.
translations.idiomatic: Vast and boundless without end—surging, immeasurable.

translations.literal: Mountains full, rivers rushing; self-generating, self-multiplying.
translations.idiomatic: Mountains overflow, rivers rush forth—all self-generating, self-multiplying.

translations.literal: What is the response?
translations.idiomatic: What shall be the response?

translations.literal: Following ritual without error.
translations.idiomatic: Following ritual without the slightest error.

translations.literal: For a hundred million years; merit extending without limit.
translations.idiomatic: For ten thousand and a hundred million years—merit extending without limit.

sentences.zh: 南呂為羽翕辟以時，協氣陶蒸。

translations.literal: Southern Pitch as yu: opening and closing in season; harmonizing qi, cultivating and nourishing.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Pitch as yu: opening and closing in season—harmonizing qi, cultivating and nourishing.

translations.literal: Spreading to metal and stone; resounding their harmonious sound.
translations.idiomatic: The sound spreads to metal and stone—resounding in harmonious voice.

translations.literal: Dark and hidden, tender and small; greatly feasting with pure sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: Dark and hidden, tender and small—they greatly feast upon pure sincerity.

translations.literal: This is what is heard—this is what is done; the state's foundation forever peaceful.
translations.idiomatic: This is what is heard, this is what is done—the state's foundation forever at peace.

sentences.zh: 盥洗，《正安》晨煬致煙，浡然四施。

translations.literal: Ablution, 《Proper Repose》: morning sunlight sends forth smoke; rushing forth to the four directions.
translations.idiomatic: Ablution, 《Proper Repose》: morning sunlight sends forth smoke—rushing forth to the four directions.

translations.literal: Drifting drifting wind-horses; as if coming here.
translations.idiomatic: Wind-horses drift and sway—as if coming here.

translations.literal: Sacrificial affairs pure and clear; pouring water, washing hands.
translations.idiomatic: The sacrificial affair is pure and clear—we pour water and wash our hands.

translations.literal: Both meticulous and solemn; none have words of shame.
translations.idiomatic: Meticulous and solemn—in nothing do we have words of shame.

sentences.zh: 升殿，《正安》崇崇其壇，屹矣層級。

translations.literal: Ascending the hall, 《Proper Repose》: lofty lofty its altar; towering in tier upon tier.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending the hall, 《Proper Repose》: lofty is the altar—towering tier upon tier.

translations.literal: Girdle sash regulated, steps measured; descending and ascending in perfect rhythm.
translations.idiomatic: Girdle sash regulated, steps measured—descent and ascent keep perfect rhythm.

translations.literal: Looking left, glancing right; auspicious winds kindly gather.
translations.idiomatic: Looking left and glancing right—auspicious winds kindly gather.

translations.literal: Pennants and feather-banners in array; bright scrutiny helping helping.
translations.idiomatic: Pennants and feather-banners in array—bright scrutiny attends on every side.

sentences.zh: 神州地祇位奠玉幣，《嘉安》

translations.literal: Spirit of the Land of the Realm seat presenting jade and silks, 《Fine Repose》
translations.idiomatic: Jade and silks presented at the Spirit of the Land of the Realm seat, 《Fine Repose》

translations.literal: Jade scepter and pearl sequence harmoniously ordered; gathering harvest, offering the fine.
translations.idiomatic: Jade scepter and pearl sequence in harmonious order—we gather the harvest and offer what is fine.

translations.literal: Clearly answering the yielding Earth Spirit; repeatedly performing refined songs.
translations.idiomatic: We clearly answer the yielding Earth Spirit—refined songs are performed again and again.

translations.literal: Silks and jade cong to assist; bearing full, qi harmonious.
translations.idiomatic: Silks and jade cong assist the rite—bearing full, spirit harmonious.

translations.literal: May the spirits broadly come; leisurely feasting in delight.
translations.idiomatic: May the spirits broadly descend—we feast at leisure in delight.

sentences.zh: 太示位奠幣，《嘉安》穆穆令聞，溥博有容。

translations.literal: Grand Display seat offering silks, 《Fine Repose》: solemn solemn fine repute; broad and ample in bearing.
translations.idiomatic: Silks offered at the Grand Display seat, 《Fine Repose》: solemn is their fine repute—broad and ample in bearing.

translations.literal: Grace covering the myriad regions; none but following in obedience.
translations.idiomatic: Grace covers the myriad regions—none but follow in obedience.

translations.literal: Reverently displaying measured silks; clearly offering the heart's intent.
translations.idiomatic: Measured silks are reverently displayed—the heart's intent is clearly offered.

translations.literal: Ritual also fitting here; feasting virtue thereby shared.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual is fitting here—feasting virtue is thereby shared.

sentences.zh: 奉俎，《豐安》肅肅嘉承，唯德其物。

translations.literal: Presenting the tray, 《Abundant Repose》: solemn solemn fine reception; only virtue in the offerings.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting the offering-tray, 《Abundant Repose》: solemnly we receive what is fine—only virtue is in the offerings.

translations.literal: The officiant priest announces; it is the people's strength.
translations.idiomatic: The officiant priest announces—it is the people's strength.

translations.literal: Brightly descending to observe; abundant blessing coming to arrive
translations.idiomatic: Brightly descending to observe—abundant blessing comes to arrive

translations.literal: (All nine seats the same) closing corner bracket〉
translations.idiomatic: (All nine seats the same) closing section mark〉

translations.literal: Period
translations.idiomatic: Full stop

sentences.zh: 亞、終獻，《文安》均調大化，陰騭下民。

translations.literal: Secondary and final offerings, 《Civil Repose》: harmonizing and adjusting the great transformation; yin favor for the people below.
translations.idiomatic: Second and final libations, 《Civil Repose》: harmonizing and adjusting the great transformation—yin favor for the people below.

translations.literal: Grand merit has grandeur; greatly raising the bright burnt offering.
translations.idiomatic: Grand merit has grandeur—greatly raising the bright burnt offering.

translations.literal: Fine goblets, second round; officers serving with diligence.
translations.idiomatic: Fine goblets, second round—officers serving with diligence.

translations.literal: Limpid and bright the aromatic wine; fortune and emolument thereby arriving.
translations.idiomatic: Limpid and bright is the aromatic wine—fortune and emolument thereby arrive.

sentences.zh: 送神，《景安》薦獻有序，降登無違。

translations.literal: Sending off the spirits, 《Splendid Repose》: offerings presented in order; descending and ascending without deviation.
translations.idiomatic: Escorting the spirits away, 《Splendid Repose》: offerings presented in order—descending and ascending without deviation.

translations.literal: Rites and music fully performed; brightly descending to feast at ease.
translations.idiomatic: Rites and music are fully performed—brightly descending to feast at ease.

translations.literal: Cloud chariot ethereal and distant; the spirit says, return home.
translations.idiomatic: Cloud chariot ethereal and distant—the spirit says, return home.

translations.literal: Repaying with glorious grant; aiding our flourishing season.
translations.idiomatic: Repaying with glorious grant—aiding our flourishing season.
